Abigail's Flower.info: Abigail's Flower is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Abigail minion. She floats towards enemies and inflicts continuous contact damage, as well as pausing to emit damaging flashes of light.

Acorn Slingshot.info: The Acorn Slingshot is a weapon that uses Acorns as ammo. It fires arcing acorns that plant themselves upon landing on a suitable soil block for a tree, but otherwise bounce and roll on blocks. If acorns reach a low enough speed without finding suitable soil or collide with an enemy, they will get destroyed and drop as items.

Adamantite Bar.info: The Adamantite Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Adamantite Forge.info: The Adamantite Forge and Titanium Forge are Hardmode crafting stations that incorporate the same functions as a regular Furnace and Hellforge, with the additional bonus of being able to smelt Adamantite, Titanium and Chlorophyte ores into their respective bars. They emit light and give off fire particles when placed, like the Furnace and Hellforge.

Adamantite Glaive.info: The Adamantite Glaive is a Hardmode spear.

Adamantite Ore.info: Adamantite Ore belongs to the third tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the third altar broken, either it or Titanium Ore can spawn in the cavern layer, roughly at lava depth. Mining Adamantite Ore requires a Mythril/Orichalcum Pickaxe or better.

Adamantite Repeater.info: The Adamantite Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Adamantite Sword.info: The Adamantite Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Adhesive Bandage.info: The Adhesive Bandage is an immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Bleeding debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Rusty Armored Bones, Werewolves, and Angler Fish.

Aerial Bane.info: The Aerial Bane is a Hardmode, post-Golem bow that has a 1/4 (25%) of being dropped from Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it converts any type of arrow into Aerial Bane arrows. The Aerial Bane fires a volley of six arrows per use, which travel in a sharp arc. Upon hitting an enemy, each arrow splits into five separate arrows, which are spread downwards.

Aglet.info: The Aglet is a pre-Hardmode movement accessory that increases the player's movement speed by 5%. The Aglet has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being found inside surface Chests, or a 1/120 (0.83%) chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing. It is also sold by the Skeleton Merchant for 2 Gold 50 Silver during a New Moon.

Ale.info: Ale is a potion that grants the Tipsy debuff for 2 minutes when consumed. Ale can be crafted at a Keg or purchased from the Tavernkeep(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) for 1 Silver each.

Ale Tosser.info: The Ale Tosser is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped from the Tavernkeep. When used, it consumes and fires Ale, which is affected by gravity and shatters upon contact with an enemy or a block, damaging enemies and affecting entities in a 9×9-tile square area. It has a 1/20 (5%) chance to inflict the Confused debuff on players in PvP and enemies for 2–5 seconds, and always inflicts Tipsy debuff on players and NPCs for 1 minute 0.98 seconds.

Amarok.info: The Amarok is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of being dropped from any enemy in the Snow biome or Ice biome, and can also drop in a Corrupted, Crimsoned, or Hallowed version of these biomes. It has a 67/100 (67%) chance to inflict the Frostbite debuff for 2–5 seconds upon hit.

Amazon.info: The Amazon is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Amber.info: Amber is a gem found within the Underground Desert of a world.

Amber Bunny.info: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.

Amber Horseshoe Balloon.info: The Amber Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that increases jump height by 75% (6 blocks → 10.5 blocks), reduces it by 15% when underwater (8 blocks → 7 blocks), makes the player immune to fall damage, and releases bees when attacked, which seek out and damage enemies. It also grants +0.05 luck(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). It can be crafted at a Tinkerer's Workshop with a Lucky Horseshoe and a Honey Balloon.

Amber Squirrel.info: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Amber Staff.info: The Amber Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires an orange bolt which deals 80% of the weapon's damage (16 base damage) and 100% of its knockback, and can either pierce through enemies or bounce off blocks up to 2 times, dissipating upon the 3rd hit. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).

Amethyst.info: Amethyst is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. Out of all available gems, Amethyst is the least valuable gem, being able to craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and has no exclusive recipes.

Amethyst Bunny.info: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.

Amethyst Squirrel.info: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Amethyst Staff.info: The Amethyst Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a purple bolt which does not pierce and homes onto the closest enemy within a 31.25-tile radius. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).

Amphibian Boots.info: The Amphibian Boots are an accessory crafted by combining the Sailfish Boots and Frog Leg at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It provides the benefits of both.

Anchor.info: The Anchor is a Hardmode flail that has a 3.78% chance of being found in Pearlwood Crates, obtained from fishing. When used, it fires an Anchor in an arc, which is attached to the player via a rope. The Anchor can pierce an unlimited number of enemies in its way and returns upon hitting solid blocks or after traveling for more than 50 tiles away from the player.

Ancient Chisel.info: The Ancient Chisel is a construction accessory that increases mining speed by 25%, similarly to a Mining Potion. It can be found in Sandstone Chests in the top 4/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.

Ancient Manipulator.info: The Ancient Manipulator is a Hardmode crafting station that is always dropped by the Lunatic Cultist. It is mainly used to craft items from Luminite and Lunar Fragments.

Angel Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Angler Earring.info: The Angler Earring is an accessory that increases the player's current Fishing Power by 10 when equipped. The Angler Earring can be acquired as a 1/34 (2.94%) chance reward for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC, depending on the number of completed quests and other factors (see Angler § Quest rewards for details).

Angler Tackle Bag.info: The Angler Tackle Bag is an accessory that combines the functionality of its components: the Angler Earring's +10 boost to Fishing Power, the Tackle Box's chance to not consume bait, and the unbreakable quality of the High Test Fishing Line.

Ankh Charm.info: The Ankh Charm is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the following debuffs.

Ankh Shield.info: The Ankh Shield is a Hardmode shield and immunity accessory.

Anklet of the Wind.info: The Anklet of the Wind is an accessory that gives a 10% bonus to movement speed. The effect also stacks with the movement speed bonus of the Aglet. It can be found in Jungle and Bramble Crates with a 19% chance, and also in Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle with a 22.17% chance.

Antlion Mandible.info: The Antlion Mandible is a crafting material dropped by Antlions, Antlion Larvae, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers found in the Desert and Underground Desert biomes.

Any Adamantite Bar.info: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. These alternatives are grouped as "Any <groupname>". For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be crafted with regular Wood, Ebonwood, Shadewood, etc.

For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be crafted with regular Wood, Ebonwood, Shadewood, etc.

Any Wood.info: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. These alternatives are grouped as "Any <groupname>". For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be crafted with regular Wood, Ebonwood, Shadewood, etc.

Apprentice's Scarf.info: The Apprentice's Scarf is an accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%. It is dropped by the Dark Mage with a 1/4 (25%) / 1/2 (50%) chance.

Aqua Scepter.info: The Aqua Scepter is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires arcing streams of water in quick succession, with each stream being able to hit up to 5 targets. The water streams bounce upwards upon colliding with lava. They pierce infinitely after a bounce, move slower, are less affected by gravity and can last for a significantly longer time.

Arc Surge.info: The Arc Surge is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic weapon that has a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When used, it rapidly fires instantaneous red lightning arcs at the cursor's location, which can reach anywhere on the screen and pierce enemies infinitely with no damage penalty, but cannot pass through blocks or enter liquids.

Arcane Flower.info: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory.

Architect Gizmo Pack.info: The Architect Gizmo Pack is a construction accessory.

Arctic Diving Gear.info: The Arctic Diving Gear is an accessory which is crafted by combining the Jellyfish Diving Gear and Ice Skates at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Argon Moss.info: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Argon Moss Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Arkhalis.info: The Arkhalis is a Hardmode melee weapon that is part of Arkhalis' set and is only obtainable through Hardmode Treasure Bags in Expert Mode (except Queen Slime's). It appears to be a sword, but does not present an actual blade when used. Instead of an overhead broadsword swing or a shortsword stab, the Arkhalis autoswings and appears as a series of blurred slashes aimed in the direction of the cursor. Anything within this area takes constant damage at a rate far exceeding the weapon's stated use time.

Arkhalis' Lightwings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Armlet Of Ruin.info: The Armlet Of Ruin is a Hardmode accessory.

Armor Bracing.info: Armor Bracing is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Weak and Broken Armor debuffs.

Armor Polish.info: The Armor Polish is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Broken Armor debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Armored Skeletons and Blue Armored Bones.

Artery.info: The Artery is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Ash Wood.info: Ash Wood is a type of wood harvested from Ash trees found naturally growing in Ash forests. Ash trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Ash grass at any height.

Ash Wood Bow.info: The Ash Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Ash Wood Sword.info: The Ash Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Autohammer.info: The Autohammer is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Shroomite Bars as well as Mini Nuke I and II. It can be purchased from the Truffle for 1 Platinum after Plantera has been defeated.

Avenger Emblem.info: The Avenger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that grants 12% increased damage to all weapons.

Ball O' Hurt.info: The Ball O' Hurt is a pre-Hardmode flail that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption.

Ballista Cane.info: The Ballista Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Ballista sentry fires Ballista Shot projectiles towards enemies, which pierce three times. Ballistas deal high damage but have a slow firing speed. The higher the tier, the more damage the Ballistas deal.

Ballista Rod.info: The Ballista Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Ballista sentry fires Ballista Shot projectiles towards enemies, which pierce three times. Ballistas deal high damage but have a slow firing speed. The higher the tier, the more damage the Ballistas deal.

Ballista Staff.info: The Ballista Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Ballista sentry fires Ballista Shot projectiles towards enemies, which pierce three times. Ballistas deal high damage but have a slow firing speed. The higher the tier, the more damage the Ballistas deal.

Balloon Pufferfish.info: The Balloon Pufferfish is an accessory that has identical function to the Shiny Red Balloon. It increases the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the height that the player can jump from 6 tiles to ~10½ tiles, effectively a ~75% boost; however, it reduces jump height when underwater, from 8 tiles to 7 tiles. It can be obtained via fishing in any biome.

Bananarang.info: The Bananarang is a Hardmode boomerang that is dropped by the Clown during Blood Moon with a 1/10 (10%) chance. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of ten Bananarangs that can be thrown out at one time.

Band of Regeneration.info: The Band of Regeneration is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers and in Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second. This effect stacks with the player's natural health regeneration, but unlike the natural regeneration, does not slow or stop when the player is moving or being attacked.

Band of Starpower.info: The Band of Starpower is an accessory that increases the player's maximum mana by 40. The Band of Starpower has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption. It can also be crafted, making it easier to obtain in Crimson worlds.

Barnacle Staff.info: The Barnacle Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Barnacle sentry. It floats in midair and fires poison spit at enemies, which inflicts the Poisoned debuff for 5–10 seconds. After being summoned, the Barnacle is carried upwards by its balloons until it is at least 15 tiles above the ground directly underneath it. Coming in contact with solid blocks causes the balloons to pop and the Barnacle to attach itself to the underside of the blocks.

Barrel Launcher.info: The Barrel Launcher is a Hardmode ranged weapon that fires multi-colored Barrels without consuming any ammunition. The Barrels are heavily affected by gravity, bounce off blocks, and explode upon contact with an enemy or after 3 seconds have passed. After bouncing for the first time, the barrels gain a glowing effect and their damage increases to 133% of the weapon's damage (133 base damage). Bouncing again does not increase the damage further.

Bat Bat.info: The Bat Bat is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of being dropped by any type of bat. When swung, it restores 1 health to the user upon hitting an enemy.

Bat Scepter.info: The Bat Scepter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. When used, it fires a burst of 2–3 homing bats, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.

Bat Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Beam Sword.info: The Beam Sword is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/150 (0.67%) chance of being dropped by Armored Skeletons. When swung, it fires a yellow Sword Beam projectile that can pierce one enemy and bounce off blocks three times before dissipating.

Bee Cloak.info: The Bee Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Star Cloak and the Honey Comb. When the player is injured, three stars will fall on the player's current location and bees are released.

Bee Gun.info: The Bee Gun is a pre-Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee. When used, it fires a burst of Bee projectiles that home in on enemies, can pierce enemies twice or bounce on blocks three times, and have a 1/2 (50%) chance to deal 1 extra damage.

Bee Keeper.info: The Bee Keeper is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee. When swung, it will inflict the Confused debuff on hit for 2 seconds. It also summons a burst of 1–3 Bee projectiles on hit, which home in on enemies, deal 1/3 (33.33%) of the weapon's damage (10 base damage), can pierce enemies twice and bounce on blocks three times, and have a 1/2 (50%) to deal 1 extra damage.

Bee Wax.info: Bee Wax is a crafting material dropped by the Queen Bee. It cannot be crafted or placed. It takes 44 to craft a set of Bee armor and the Hornet Staff, which amounts to killing Queen Bee 2–3 times.

Bee Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Beenade.info: The Beenade is a consumable ranged weapon that acts similarly to a regular Grenade when thrown but releases 15–24 friendly bee projectiles upon detonating after 3 seconds. These bee projectiles deal 100% of the Beenade's damage (12 base damage) per hit and have a 1/2 (50%) chance to deal 1 extra damage, but cannot inflict critical hits.

Beetle Husk.info: The Beetle Husk is a Hardmode, post-Golem crafting material dropped by Golem.

Beetle Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Berserker's Glove.info: The Berserker's Glove is a Hardmode accessory.

Betsy's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Betsy's Wrath.info: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post-Golem wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

Bezoar.info: The Bezoar is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Poisoned debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Hornets, Moss Hornets, and Toxic Sludges.

Black Belt.info: The Black Belt is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that grants a 1/10 (10%) chance to dodge an attack, including instances of damage taken from hazards such as traps and lava. A cloud of smoke surrounds the player when performing a dodge. The Black Belt has a 1/12 (8.33%) / 23/144 (15.97%) chance of being dropped by Bone Lees in the post-Plantera Dungeon.

Black Counterweight.info: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player. Counterweights deal the yoyo's full damage and stay active until the yoyo is retracted towards the player. There are six different color variants with identical functionalities.

Black Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Black Fairy Dust.info: Black Fairy Dust is a crafting material used solely to craft Tattered Fairy Wings. It is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave.

Black Ink.info: Black Ink is a dye material that is dropped by Squids, which only spawn in the Ocean biome. Its sole purpose is to make Black Dye.

Black Lens.info: The Black Lens is a crafting material dropped by Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes at a 1/100 (1%) chance.

Black String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Blade Staff.info: The Blade Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons an Enchanted Dagger minion. It flies towards enemies and slashes through them repeatedly at a fast pace. It also has 25 armor penetration. Enchanted Daggers arrange themselves along a carousel above the player's head, and immediately return to the player if no enemies are nearby. The Blade Staff has a 1/4 (25%) / 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by Queen Slime.

Blade of Grass.info: The Blade of Grass is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a Leaf Blade projectile that travels upwards in a circle and homes in on enemies. The Leaf Blade projectile can pass through blocks, deals 25% of the weapon's damage (4 base damage), has 20 armor penetration, and can pierce two enemies. The sword and its projectiles both have a 1/4 (25%) chance of inflicting the Poisoned debuff for 7 seconds upon hit.

Bladed Glove.info: The Bladed Glove is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a roughly 1/2000 (0.05%) chance of being dropped by most weak enemies during the Halloween seasonal event. It has a very short range, but an exceptionally high attack speed.

Bladetongue.info: The Bladetongue is a Hardmode broadsword that can be obtained extremely rarely by fishing in the Crimson biome in any layer.

Blindfold.info: The Blindfold is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Darkness debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Corrupt Slimes, Slimelings, Crimslimes, Dark Mummies, and Blood Mummies.

Blinkroot.info: Blinkroot is a type of herb that appears as stems with glowing dots. It grows naturally on Dirt or Mud Blocks, regardless of lighting or elevation, as long as the blocks bear no grass of any kind. Blinkroot can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool, and can be planted manually using Blinkroot Seeds in Clay Pots and Planter Boxes, or on suitable soil tiles.

Blizzard Staff.info: The Blizzard Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped from the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave. When used, it causes a wide spread of icicles to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. It summons four icicles per use, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.

Blizzard in a Balloon.info: The Blizzard in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Blizzard in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon. It boosts jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the player's first jump's height to ~10½ tiles (~75% increase), and provides a double jump that can reach a height of 14½ tiles, for a total height of 25 tiles.

Blizzard in a Bottle.info: The Blizzard in a Bottle is a pre-Hardmode accessory which works similarly to the Cloud in a Bottle, allowing the player to double-jump. Instead of a cloud being produced when the player jumps, a trail of snow is produced at the player's feet. The Blizzard jump goes 8 tiles into the air, totaling 14 tiles when put together with the first jump.

Blood Butcherer.info: The Blood Butcherer is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it inflicts the Blood Butchered debuff upon enemy hits for 9 seconds and causing enemies to visibly bleed, dealing 4 damage per second (4 damage displayed every 1 second). Repeated attacks will cause the debuff to stack up to 5 times, for a total of 20 damage per second (20 damage displayed every 1 second).

Blood Rain Bow.info: The Blood Rain Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Mermen. When used, it converts any type of arrow into a spread of 1–3 streams of blood (average of 1.83 streams) to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. Each use only consumes one arrow. The streams dissipate upon contact with an enemy or a block.

Blood Thorn.info: The Blood Thorn is a Hardmode magic weapon that summons three penetrating Blood Thorn projectiles upon use, which erupt from solid blocks and platforms to damage enemies near the player's cursor. It has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks.

Blood Water.info: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome (Hallow, Corruption, or Crimson for Holy Water, Unholy Water, and Blood Water respectively) when thrown. This conversion affects a roughly circular area with a radius of four tiles from the center. Enemies within this radius are also damaged slightly; this damage is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment.

Bloody Machete.info: The Bloody Machete is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that has a 1/2000 (0.05%) chance of being dropped by most weak enemies during the Halloween seasonal event. When thrown, it falls downward after reaching a medium range, then returns to the player upon contact with a block or an enemy. It also inflicts the Bleeding debuff on hit.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Blowgun.info: The Blowgun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for 5 Gold. It is an indirect upgrade to the Blowpipe. When used, it fires Seeds and darts as ammunition. While a Blowgun is in a player's inventory, there is a chance that any vegetation growing on normal grass, in Clay Pots, and in Planter Boxes will drop Seeds. Flowers typically drop 4 Seeds at a time, while tall grass typically drops 1–2 Seeds.

Blowpipe.info: The Blowpipe is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being obtained from wooden Chests on the Surface or in the Underground layer. When used, it fires Seeds and darts as ammunition. While a Blowpipe is in a player's inventory, there is a chance that any vegetation growing on normal grass, in Clay Pots, and in Planter Boxes will drop Seeds. Flowers typically drop 4 Seeds at a time, while tall grass typically drops 1–2 Seeds.

Blue Berries.info: Blue Berries are a dye material and type of plant. Placed Blue Berries have the appearance of a blueberry bush. They can grow on regular grass or Jungle grass above surface. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Blue Dye.

Blue Counterweight.info: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player. Counterweights deal the yoyo's full damage and stay active until the yoyo is retracted towards the player. There are six different color variants with identical functionalities.

Blue Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Blue Horseshoe Balloon.info: The Blue Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 75%, grants a double-jump, and grants +0.05 luck(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). The height of the first jump is increased from 6 blocks to 10.5 blocks, while the double-jump's height is increased from 5 blocks to 9 blocks, reaching a total of 19.5 blocks with both jumps.

Blue Moon.info: The Blue Moon is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron flail that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes.

Blue Phaseblade.info: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them. They can be recalled by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again, which will damage enemies along the way. They can also be recalled mid-throw.

Blue Phasesaber.info: Phasesabers are a group of Hardmode broadswords, direct upgrades to the phaseblades with much more damage and slightly faster use time. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them.

Blue Rocket.info: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 Silver each.

Blue String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Bomb.info: The Bomb is an explosive that explodes 3 seconds after being thrown. The explosion breaks nearly all blocks, background walls, and furniture within a 4-tile radius, except explosion-proof objects. The explosion also deals 100 damage to all enemies, critters, and players in the radius, but not NPCs. The Bomb works in liquids. A lit Bomb can be defused by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it, canceling the explosion and safely dropping the Bomb as an item for the player to pick it back up.

Bomb Fish.info: The Bomb Fish is an explosive that functions identically to the Sticky Bomb, but does not slow down in water. It is obtained through fishing, with the number obtained depending on the player's Fishing Power.

Bone.info: Bones are crafting materials and consumable ranged weapons. They are dropped by Angry Bones, Dark Casters, Cursed Skulls, and Librarian Skeletons which spawn in the Dungeon.

Bone Feather.info: The Bone Feather is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material used solely to craft Bone Wings. It has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of being dropped by any Armored Bones variant (Blue, Rusty, or Hell Armored Bones) in the Dungeon after Plantera has been defeated.

Bone Glove.info: The Bone Glove is a pre-Hardmode accessory that throws ricocheting crossbones every time a weapon is used, at a maximum of once per second. The crossbones projectiles ricochet off walls three times or pierce two enemies before being destroyed, deal 25 classless damage, and additionally have 25 armor penetration. The Bone Glove is always dropped from Skeletron's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Bone Helm.info: The Bone Helm is a pre-Hardmode accessory that summons Shadow Hand projectiles to damage enemies. These Shadow Hands spawn a distance from enemies before flying at them, piercing anything in their path including through blocks. Their flight behavior mirrors the Shadow Hands found in the Deerclops fight, either flying straight or swerving harshly in flight. The Bone Helm is always dropped from Deerclops' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Bone Javelin.info: The Bone Javelin is a consumable ranged weapon crafted from Sturdy Fossils. Upon hitting an enemy, it will stick to the enemy and inflict the Penetrated debuff for 15 seconds, dealing 3 damage per second (3 damage displayed every 1 second). Up to six Bone Javelins can be stuck onto an enemy, dealing a total of 18 damage per second (18 damage displayed every 1 second).

Bone Sword.info: The Bone Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by Skeletons and Spore Skeletons. Upon hitting an enemy, it releases a non-piercing lobbed bone projectile that is affected by gravity, and deals 75% of the weapon's damage (14 base damage) and its full knockback.

Bone Throwing Knife.info: The Bone Throwing Knife is a consumable ranged weapon similar to Throwing Knives. It can hit up to 6 targets. Combined with fossil armor, it can be an effective weapon against the Eater of Worlds due to its piercing.

Bone Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Book.info: The Book is a crafting material used only to craft Bookcases, Pianos, and Librarian Blocks. It can also be placed as decoration on Flat-surface items. Books are found placed on the Dungeon's many shelves, where they can be freed with a pickaxe or drill. They can also be renewably obtained from Dungeon or Stockade Crates, and can be bought from the Wizard for 15 Silver each.

Book of Skulls.info: The Book of Skulls is a pre-Hardmode spell book that has a 36/343 (10.5%) / 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by Skeletron. When used, it fires slow-moving skull projectiles which home in on enemies, can pierce twice before dissipating on the third hit, can pass through blocks, and emit a fair amount of light.

Bookcase.info: Bookcases are a type of flat-surface furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons (the Crystal Storm, Cursed Flames, and Golden Shower) as well as the Librarian furniture out of Librarian Blocks. Bookcases also fulfill a house's table requirement.

Boomstick.info: The Boomstick is a pre-Hardmode gun. It can be found in Ivy Chests (22.17% chance) in the Underground Jungle, and also in Jungle Crates (19/100 (19%) chance). When used, it fires a spread of 3–4 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Boreal Wood.info: Boreal Wood is a type of wood harvested from Boreal trees found naturally growing in the Snow biome, or from Underground Cabins in the Ice biome. Boreal trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Snow Blocks above surface.

Boreal Wood Bow.info: The Boreal Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Boreal Wood Sword.info: The Boreal Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Bottle.info: A Bottle is a crafting material required to craft most potions. Like the Pink Vase, Mug, and different Cups, placing it (on most "flat-surface items" or a platform) allows it to act as a Placed Bottle where the player can craft potions. Bottles can also be "filled" when standing near water or honey, turning them into Bottled Water or Bottled Honey, respectively.

Bottled Water.info: Bottled Water is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion. It can be crafted at a sink or a body of water. Bottled Water mainly serves as the basis of almost every craftable potion in the game, and is also required for crafting flasks.

Bouncy Bomb.info: The Bouncy Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but bounces off blocks more intensely.

Bouncy Dynamite.info: Bouncy Dynamite is an explosive that functions like Dynamite, but bounces off blocks more intensely.

Bouncy Grenade.info: The Bouncy Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon made of Pink Gel and Grenades. Instead of rolling or sticking in place upon contact with tiles, it will bounce and retain much of its momentum.

Brain of Confusion.info: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Brand of the Inferno.info: The Brand of the Inferno is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss broadsword. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance of inflicting the Hellfire debuff for five seconds on hit and also allows the player to parry incoming damage while equipped with a shield.

Breaker Blade.info: The Breaker Blade is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh. It has a larger size than most other swords. It deals 250% damage (175 base damage) to enemies at 90% health or higher.

Breathing Reed.info: The Breathing Reed is a tool that aids in underwater breathing, and also functions as a broadsword. It has a 9/40 (22.5%) chance of being found in Water Chests, Ocean Crates, and Seaside Crates.

Brick Layer.info: The Brick Layer is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 Gold. While equipped, it grants +50% placement speed when placing blocks.

Broken Bat Wing.info: The Broken Bat Wing is a rare Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft Bat Wings. It has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance of being dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse.

Broken Hero Sword.info: The Broken Hero Sword is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material that has a 1/4 (25%) / 7/16 (43.75%) chance of being dropped by Mothrons.

Brown Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Brown String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Bubble Gun.info: The Bubble Gun is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it rapidly fires a large spread of short-range bubbles, with three bubbles per use. Bubble projectiles gradually slow down and dissipate upon contact with an enemy or block, or after 1.67 seconds.

Bundle of Balloons.info: The Bundle of Balloons is an accessory that allows the wearer to perform a quadruple jump, as well as increasing the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%.

Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons.info: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

Bunny Cannon.info: The Bunny Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture/weapon. It can be purchased from the Pirate for 50 Gold when the Party Girl is present and one of the mechanical bosses has been defeated. Once placed, it can be fired by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack key on it with any Torch (which is not consumed). The Bunny Cannon fires an arcing Explosive Bunny projectile that bounces off blocks and pierces an infinite amount of targets.

Butterfly Dust.info: Butterfly Dust is a rare Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft Butterfly Wings. It has a 1/2 (50%) chance of being dropped by Moths in the Underground Jungle.

Butterfly Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Cactus.info: Cactus is a crafting material obtained by harvesting Cactus plants, using an axe or chainsaw just like with trees. In addition to crafting, Cactus can be used as a building material.

Cactus Sword.info: The Cactus Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Candy Cane Sword.info: The Candy Cane Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 0.639% (pre-Hardmode) / 0.596% (Hardmode) chance to be obtained from Presents dropped during the Christmas event.

Candy Corn Rifle.info: The Candy Corn Rifle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that consumes Candy Corn as ammunition. When used, it rapidly fires Candy Corn shots that pierce up to two enemies and ricochet up to four times, dissipating on their fifth impact or upon hitting a third enemy. The projectiles are affected by gravity. The Candy Corn Rifle also has a base 10% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%, and has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance not to consume ammunition.

Cannon.info: The Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture/weapon, purchased from the Pirate for 25 Gold. Once placed, it can be fired by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack key on it with any Torch (which is not consumed). The Cannon fires an arcing Cannonball that explodes upon contact with a block. The Cannonball can also pierce through three enemies, exploding upon the fourth hit. The Cannonball and its explosion deal 300 classless damage and knockback of 8 (Very strong), and do not destroy blocks.

Cascade.info: The Cascade is a pre-Hardmode-exclusive, post-Skeletron yoyo that has a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by any enemy in or near The Underworld. Once Hardmode begins, it will no longer drop, being replaced by the Hel-Fire.

Catalyst Band.info: The Catalyst Band is a Hardmode accessory item made by combining a Poison Barb and a Philosopher's Stone at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Cattiva.info: Cattiva is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Cattiva minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, dealing contact damage. When Cattiva is falling and its target is more than 6.25 tiles above it, it can also perform a double jump with visuals similar to the Cloud in a Bottle to reach its target. Unlike the double jumps used by the player, Cattiva does not need to land on the ground to refresh its double jump and can use it endlessly while mid-air.

Celebration.info: The Celebration is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that fires two firework rocket projectiles at once, consuming one rocket. The firework rockets travel for 0.75 seconds before exploding. The Celebration can be purchased from the Party Girl for 80 Gold.

Celebration Mk2.info: The Celebration Mk2 is a Hardmode launcher that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it consumes rockets and fires one of seven special rocket types, distinguished by color. The rockets are affected by gravity to varying extents and explode upon impact with blocks.

Celestial Cuffs.info: The Celestial Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory.

Celestial Emblem.info: The Celestial Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that offers 15% increased magic damage and a 18.75-tile increased pickup range for Stars (21.375 tile total range).

Celestial Magnet.info: The Celestial Magnet is a pre-Hardmode accessory that greatly increases the pickup range for Stars. The increase in pickup range is 18.75 tiles, extending the base range of 2.625 tiles to 21.375 tiles. This effect does not stack with the Celestial Magnet's upgrades.

Celestial Shell.info: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

Celestial Starboard.info: The Celestial Starboard is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord wing-type accessory. In addition to granting remarkable flight capabilities, it has both hover and upwards boost capability. At its top speed, it travels at 82 mph horizontal, 115 mph vertical, and 51 mph while falling. The Celestial Starboard is always dropped from the Moon Lord's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Celestial Stone.info: The Celestial Stone is a Hardmode post-Golem accessory crafted from a Moon Stone and a Sun Stone at the Tinkerer's Workshop. It offers the same boosts as its components do, and as such, it is active during both day and night. It can be combined with the Moon Shell to form a Celestial Shell.

Cenx's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Chain.info: Chains are used both for climbing and as components for various crafting recipes. They are used in crafting items such as the Grappling Hook, Sawmill, all types of watches, and chandeliers. Chains can be placed and used like Rope and offer the same ascent and descent speeds, although they cannot be turned into coils like Rope can. Placed Chains are background objects, and much like furniture, do not count as background walls in a house, are not suitable for NPCs, and cannot be actuated.

Chain Guillotines.info: The Chain Guillotines are a Hardmode flail that have a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics. When used, they fire two blades attached to chains in rapid succession, with a maximum range of 32 tiles. They can pierce enemies that are very close by.

Chain Gun.info: The Chain Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that is dropped by Santa-NK1 during the Frost Moon event with a 6.25%–16.67% / 12.5%–50% chance depending on the current wave. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a wide spread. It also has a 66% chance not to consume ammunition.

Chain Knife.info: The Chain Knife is a pre-Hardmode flail that has a 1/250 (0.4%) chance of being dropped by Cave Bats. When used, it fires a knife attached to a chain that can extend up to 9.4 tiles.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Chaos Cylinder.info: The Chaos Cylinder is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) of dropping from Hallowed Mimics. While equipped, it grants +8% ranged damage and causes all ranged weapons to use ammo in special ways.

Chaos Cylinder (Full).info: The Chaos Cylinder is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) of dropping from Hallowed Mimics. While equipped, it grants +8% ranged damage and causes all ranged weapons to use ammo in special ways.

Chaos Cylinder (Random).info: The Chaos Cylinder is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) of dropping from Hallowed Mimics. While equipped, it grants +8% ranged damage and causes all ranged weapons to use ammo in special ways.

Chaos Cylinder (Simple).info: The Chaos Cylinder is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) of dropping from Hallowed Mimics. While equipped, it grants +8% ranged damage and causes all ranged weapons to use ammo in special ways.

Charged Blaster Cannon.info: The Charged Blaster Cannon is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic gun that has a 1/800 (0.13%) chance to drop from all basic enemies during the Martian Madness event. It possesses multiple firing modes with escalating speed, damage, and method of attack depending on how long the ⚒ Use / Attack key is held while firing it.

Charm of Myths.info: The Charm of Myths is a Hardmode accessory which combines the effects of the Band of Regeneration and the Philosopher's Stone. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Charm of Myths reduces it to 45 seconds.

Chicken Bones' Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Chik.info: The Chik is a Hardmode yoyo. On every 3rd yoyo hit, the Chik deals 200% damage ((68 base damage) and also shoots a spread of 5 crystal shards in random directions that can pass through blocks and travel for a short distance before disappearing. The crystal shards do not pierce, and each deal 100% of the Chik's damage ((34 base damage) and knockback (base knockback of 3.3 (Weak)).

Chippy's Cloak.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Chippy's Cloak (Inactive).info: Chippy's Cloak (Inactive) is a crafting material used solely to craft Chippy's Cloak. It is always dropped by Skeletron's Red Hat variant along with the rest of Chippy's set.

Chlorophyte Bar.info: The Chlorophyte Bar is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses bar.

Chlorophyte Claymore.info: The Chlorophyte Claymore is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses broadsword. When swung, a large green aura with a bright edge follows the swing, extending its reach and also covering behind the player. The sword also releases several short-lived spore clouds as it is swung, which are purely visual and deal no damage.

Chlorophyte Ore.info: Chlorophyte Ore is a Hardmode ore. After Hardmode starts, Mud Blocks located near Jungle grass blocks (naturally in the Underground Jungle) in or below the bottom half of the Underground layer will occasionally be replaced by Chlorophyte Ore. It requires at least a Pickaxe Axe or Drax to be mined, whose materials require defeating all three mechanical bosses.

Chlorophyte Partisan.info: The Chlorophyte Partisan is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses spear. When thrust, it fires a Spore Cloud projectile that deals the weapon's damage and knockback, lasts for a short time, can pass through blocks, and pierces an infinite number of enemies.

Chlorophyte Saber.info: The Chlorophyte Saber is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses shortsword. When used, the sword is thrusted in repeated stabbing motions with slightly varying angles for each thrust, akin to Gladius and Starlight.

Chlorophyte Shotbow.info: The Chlorophyte Shotbow is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses repeater. When used, it fires 2–3 arrows per shot, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Christmas Tree Sword.info: The Christmas Tree Sword is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% (6.22%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave. When swung, it fires a star ornament that releases a ball ornament every 0.17 seconds while traveling. The stars dissipate after piercing one enemy or after 1.67 seconds. The balls linger for 0.83 seconds before falling. Both types of projectiles cannot pass through blocks or enemies.

Chromatic Cloak.info: The Chromatic Cloak is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, touching Shimmer does not immediately inflict the Shimmering debuff, and the player can instead start Shimmering at any time by holding the ▼ Down key. However, after Shimmering starts, it cannot be interrupted, not even if the Chromatic Cloak is removed and equipped again.

Classy Cane.info: The Classy Cane is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance to be dropped by the Tax Collector. Like the Flymeal, it has the special ability to damage town NPCs, but will always only deal 1 damage to them. In addition, hitting an enemy or NPC with the Classy Cane drops 1–49 Copper Coins.

Clay Block.info: Clay is a block type mainly used as a crafting material. It is found primarily in Surface-level (above 0 elevation) areas, and is more rare at the upper parts of the Underground. Because of this, the largest deposits of Clay can be found simply by exploring the Surface for differently-colored patches in the Dirt.

Clay Bud Staff.info: The Clay Bud Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Clay Bud minion. The Clay Bud walks and jumps into enemies, dealing contact damage to them when slamming down with its arms. If the Clay Bud strays too far away from the player, it will propel itself up by using the leaves at top of its head and fly to the player. Much like Pals, the Clay Bud minion can be petted by using ⚷ Open / Activate.

Climbing Claws.info: The Climbing Claws are an accessory that lets players partially "stick" to the sides of blocks, slowly sliding down them when moving against them in midair. Jumps can also be performed off the sides of blocks. By repeatedly sticking and jumping, vertical blocks can be scaled. When sliding down, the slide speed can be accelerated using the ▼ Down key. Climbing Claws have a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being found inside surface Chests, or a 1/120 (0.83%) chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing.

Clinger Staff.info: The Clinger Staff is a Hardmode magic weapon that generates a 15-tile high wall of Cursed Flame, which deals damage and inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff to enemies that walk through it for a duration of 7 seconds. The point at which the wall is generated must be in a direct line of sight; otherwise, the wall will not generate, though still consume mana.

Clockwork Assault Rifle.info: The Clockwork Assault Rifle is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When used, it fires in three-shot bursts, with each burst consuming one piece of ammunition.

Clothier Voodoo Doll.info: The Clothier Voodoo Doll is a boss-summoning item used to summon Skeletron after it has been defeated. It has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance to drop from Angry Bones, Dark Casters, and Librarian Skeletons in the Dungeon.

Cloud in a Balloon.info: The Cloud in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the functionality of the Cloud in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon. It boosts jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the player's first jump's height to 10.5 tiles (~75% increase), and provides a double jump that can reach a height of 9 tiles, for a total height of 19.5 tiles.

Cloud in a Bottle.info: The Cloud in a Bottle is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. When equipped, it allows the player an extra jump. The extra jump has a 75% jump duration compared to a normal jump, increasing the maximum height the player can reach without other accessories by 5 tiles, for a total of 11 tiles.

Cobalt Bar.info: The Cobalt Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Cobalt Naginata.info: The Cobalt Naginata is a Hardmode spear.

Cobalt Ore.info: Cobalt Ore belongs to the first tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the first altar broken, either it or Palladium Ore can spawn in the underground and cavern layers. Mining Cobalt Ore requires a Molten Pickaxe or better.

Cobalt Repeater.info: The Cobalt Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Cobalt Shield.info: The Cobalt Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). While equipped, it grants 1 defense and immunity to knockback.

Cobalt Sword.info: The Cobalt Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Cobweb.info: Cobwebs are crafting materials used to craft Silk and other items. Cobwebs can also be placed. Placed Cobwebs catch players who fall into them and reset fall damage. They break after a short time when a player is stuck in them, and they can also be harvested instantly with any weapon or swung tool.

Cobwhip.info: The Cobwhip is a pre-Hardmode whip.

Code 1.info: The Code 1 is a pre-Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 Gold once the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated.
