Code 2.info: The Code 2 is a Hardmode, post one-mechanical boss yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 25 Gold.

Coin Gun.info: The Coin Gun is a Hardmode ranged weapon that uses coins as ammunition, which affects its damage and velocity depending on the type of coin fired. The weapon itself has 0 base damage, with the entirety of its damage value stemming from the coins used to fire it. Coin projectiles dissipate upon hitting an enemy or solid block and cannot be retrieved once fired. The Coin Gun is dropped very rarely (1/4000 (0.025%) chance) by regular Pirate Invasion enemies, excluding the Parrot.

Coin Ring.info: The Coin Ring is a Hardmode accessory created by other accessories exclusively dropped from pirate enemies during Pirate Invasion. It combines the effect of Gold Ring and Lucky Coin, which increases the pickup range for coins, and causes enemies to occasionally drop 1 to 10 more coins when hit and grants +0.05 luck.

Combat Wrench.info: The Combat Wrench is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron boomerang that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by the Mechanic. It can pierce multiple targets before returning.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Compass.info: The Compass is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the player's horizontal position. Position is shown in the number of feet (1 foot = 1/2 tile) to the east or west of the center of the map. The centerpoint of the map is usually very close to the initial spawn point.

Cool Whip.info: The Cool Whip is a Hardmode whip.

Copper Bar.info: The Copper Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Copper Bow.info: The Copper Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Copper Broadsword.info: The Copper Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Copper Shortsword.

Copper Ore.info: Copper Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Copper Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Copper Shortsword.info: The Copper Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Copper Broadsword. Newly created characters spawn with a Copper Shortsword (Iron Shortsword in Journey Mode).

Copper Watch.info: Watches are informational accessories that show the current in-game time in the top-right corner of the screen.

Corrupt Seeds.info: Corrupt Seeds are seeds used to plant Corrupt grass on Dirt Blocks or Corrupt Jungle grass on Mud Blocks, which will then spread The Corruption in all directions. They drop from the Eye of Cthulhu and can be purchased from the Dryad for 5 Silver each during a Blood Moon in a world with Corruption. In a world with Crimson, Corrupt Seeds can be purchased from the Dryad if she is spoken to in a Hardmode Graveyard.

Countercurse Mantra.info: The Countercurse Mantra is an immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Silenced and Cursed debuffs.

Crimsand Block.info: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions. Sand can spread and be converted by the evil biomes and The Hallow (see below).

Crimsandstone Block.info: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome.

Crimson Rod.info: The Crimson Rod is a pre-Hardmode magic weapon that launches a reddish rain cloud towards the cursor, where it rains damaging blood droplets downward onto enemies below. One cloud projectile can be placed at a time and it does not pass through terrain, instead stopping if it hits a surface before it reaches its target location. Once placed, the cloud will remain for five minutes but can be removed early by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it, similarly to the Nimbus Rod's cloud.

Crimson Seeds.info: Crimson Seeds are seeds used to plant Crimson grass on Dirt Blocks or Crimson Jungle grass on Mud Blocks, which will then spread The Crimson in all directions. They drop from the Eye of Cthulhu and can be purchased from the Dryad for 5 Silver each during a Blood Moon in a world with Crimson. In a world with Corruption, Crimson Seeds can be purchased from the Dryad if she is spoken to in a Hardmode Graveyard.

Crimstone Block.info: Crimstone is a block type found in The Crimson. Before Hardmode, it is most prominent in the lining of Chasms. It requires at least 65% pickaxe power (Deathbringer Pickaxe / Nightmare Pickaxe, or better) or explosives to mine. Deathweed can grow on it.

Crimtane Bar.info: The Crimtane Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Crimtane Ore.info: Crimtane Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It is primarily dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu, as well as the Eye of Cthulhu in Crimson worlds. Crimtane Ore can also be found rarely in small veins underground. When below 0 ft in elevation, a Gold Pickaxe or better is needed to mine it, otherwise any pickaxe can be used.

Cross Necklace.info: The Cross Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that increases the duration of the invincibility frames a player is afforded after taking damage. The Cross Necklace has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance to be dropped by Mimics.

Crossed Heart Necklace.info: The Crossed Heart Necklace is a Hardmode accessory item made by combining a Panic Necklace and a Cross Necklace at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Crowno's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Crystal Ball.info: The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station. It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 Gold. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

Crystal Serpent.info: The Crystal Serpent is a Hardmode wand that can be obtained extremely rarely by fishing in The Hallow biome in any layer.

Crystal Shard.info: Crystal Shards are a common Hardmode crafting material found in the Underground Hallow. They can naturally grow on the left, right, and bottom sides of Pearlstone, Pink Ice, Pearlsand, Hardened Pearlsand, and Pearlsandstone Blocks. Due to their constant regrowth, they can be farmed (see Guide:Farming resources § Crystal Shards for details). Crystal Shards emit a small glow, similar to Demonite Ore and Crimtane Ore. They do not spread the Hallow.

Crystal Storm.info: The Crystal Storm is a Hardmode spell book that rapidly fires a slight spread of small crystal shards. The shards last for 2.5 seconds each and slow down as they travel. They can bounce off blocks an unlimited amount of times for their duration, and do not pierce.

Crystal Vile Shard.info: The Crystal Vile Shard is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it extends a crystal spike from the player's position, which passes through blocks, pierces infinite enemies, and deals 0.17 s global invincibility.

Cursed Flame.info: Cursed Flame is a Hardmode crafting material, whose Crimson counterpart is Ichor. It is dropped by World Feeders, Vile Ghouls and Clingers, all of which can be found in The Corruption. It can also be found in Defiled Crates.

Cursed Flames.info: The Cursed Flames are a Hardmode spell book that fire gravity-affected bouncing green fireballs. The fireballs can bounce off blocks four times and pierce enemies once, and they inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds on hit, dealing 24 damage per second.

Cutlass.info: The Cutlass is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by regular Pirate Invasion enemies (excluding the Parrot), a 1/50 (2%) chance from Pirate Captains, and a 1/10 (10%) chance from the Flying Dutchman. Striking enemies with the weapon increases its damage by 12% per hit, up to a maximum of 50%. This damage bonus decays at a rate of 0.5% per tick or 30% per second.

Cyan Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Cyan Gradient Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Cyan Husk.info: The Cyan Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Cyan Beetles, which only spawn in the Underground Snow biome. Its sole purpose is to make Cyan Dye.

Cyan String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

D-Town's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

DPS Meter.info: The DPS Meter is an informational accessory that displays the DPS of the weapon that last dealt damage to any entity, including enemies, critters, NPCs, Target Dummies, and other players.

Daedalus Stormbow.info: The Daedalus Stormbow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it causes a wide spread of arrows to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. It fires two to four arrows per use, while only consuming a single arrow from the player's inventory.

Dao of Pow.info: The Dao of Pow is a Hardmode flail. It has a 4/5 (80%) chance of inflicting the Confused debuff for 2–4 seconds upon striking an enemy.

Dark Harvest.info: The Dark Harvest is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that is dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave.

Dark Lance.info: The Dark Lance is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron spear that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates. The Dark Lance inflicts the Shadowflame debuff for 4–5 seconds and creates a small shockwave at its tip.

Dark Shard.info: The Dark Shard is a Hardmode crafting material used in the crafting of the Dao of Pow, Onyx Blaster and Ruinous Staff. It has a 1/10 (10%) chance of being dropped by Dark Mummies and Shadow Mummies(Old-gen console and 3DS versions) in Corrupt Deserts, and Blood Mummies(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) in Crimson Deserts.

Dart Pistol.info: The Dart Pistol is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Crimson counterpart to the Corruption's Dart Rifle, with a higher rate of fire but lower damage. It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics.

Dart Rifle.info: The Dart Rifle is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Corruption counterpart to the Crimson's Dart Pistol, with higher damage but a lower rate of fire. It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics.

Daybloom.info: Daybloom is a type of herb that appears as a small yellow flower with a straight green stem. It grows naturally on regular grass and Hallowed grass. Daybloom can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool, and can be planted manually using Daybloom Seeds in Clay Pots and Planter Boxes, or on suitable soil tiles.

Daybloom Staff.info: The Daybloom Staff is an early pre-Hardmode wand which fires a short-ranged burst of 4 non-piercing yellow pellets toward the cursor with slight inaccuracy.

Daybreak.info: The Daybreak is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist melee weapon that fires a gravity-affected sun spear projectile. It sticks onto the targeted enemy upon contact, dealing damage and inflicting the Daybroken debuff, which deals 100 damage per second for a duration of 5 seconds. Up to eight sun spears can be stuck onto a single enemy at one time, resulting in 800 DPS for the debuff.

Deadly Sphere Staff.info: The Deadly Sphere Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Deadly Sphere minion. It flies and charges through enemies at a high velocity but cannot move through blocks. Once every three attacks, it briefly stops in place to cycle through one of three forms before continuing to attack. The Deadly Sphere Staff has a 1/30 (3.33%) / 59/900 (6.56%) chance of being dropped by Deadly Spheres.

Death Sickle.info: The Death Sickle is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/40 (2.5%) / 79/1600 (4.94%) chance of being dropped by Reapers during the Solar Eclipse event. When swung, it fires a spinning purple sickle that can pass through blocks. The sickles travel slowly for about 12 tiles before stopping in place, can pierce four enemies, or linger for three seconds before dissipating.

Demon Altar.info: Demon Altars and Crimson Altars are naturally-occurring crafting stations found mainly in and around chasms in The Corruption or Crimson, and less frequently underground. They are used to craft pre-Hardmode boss-summoning items and the Night's Edge as well as the Void Bag and Vault. Placed altars emit some light, making them easy to spot. They cannot be freed, picked up, or crafted. A Demon or Crimson Altar item will drop from the Eye of Cthulhu if no altars are present in the world.

drops.note: (when no altar is placed in world with additional conditions)

Demon Bow.info: The Demon Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Demon Scythe.info: The Demon Scythe is a pre-Hardmode spell book that has a 1/35 (2.86%) chance of being dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons. When used, it fires a sickle projectile that is initially static before gradually accelerating. The sickles can hit up to five times before dissipating, and they cannot pass through blocks.

Demon Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Demonite Bar.info: The Demonite Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Demonite Ore.info: Demonite Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It is primarily dropped from the Eater of Worlds, as well as the Eye of Cthulhu in Corruption worlds. Demonite Ore can also be found rarely in small veins underground. When below 0 ft in elevation, a Gold Pickaxe or better is needed to mine it, otherwise any pickaxe can be used.

Depth Meter.info: The Depth Meter is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the player's vertical position, or depth. Depth is relative to the boundary between the Surface and Underground layers, which has a depth of 0 and is displayed as "Level". Depth is shown in the number of feet (1 foot = 1/2 tile) to this boundary, and is measured from the player's feet. The display also shows the name of the current layer.

Desert Spirit Lamp.info: The Desert Spirit Lamp is a decorative Hardmode furniture item and crafting material. It can only be placed on flat-surface furniture. It has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance of being dropped from Desert Spirits, which can be encountered in the Corrupted or Crimson Underground Desert.

Desert Tiger Staff.info: The Desert Tiger Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Desert Tiger minion. It runs towards enemies to deal contact damage. Every six seconds, the tiger can perform a pounce attack at nearby enemies, dealing 50% extra damage (+20 base damage) and passing through blocks to reach them.

Destroyer Emblem.info: The Destroyer Emblem is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that gives the player 10% increased damage and 8% increased critical strike chance.

Diamond.info: Diamond is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Diamond Bunny.info: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.

Diamond Squirrel.info: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Diamond Staff.info: The Diamond Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a bright white bolt which can pierce once and has a large hitbox, indicated by the faint, extra shine. While wearing a gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).

Dirt Block.info: The Dirt Block is one of the most common blocks in Terraria, occurring naturally almost everywhere throughout the world. All caves above the elevation of 0 ft are made of Dirt. Below 0 ft, in the underground layer, the caves are made of roughly 50% Dirt. Small patches of Dirt can be found in the cavern layer, though it is mostly made of Stone.

Dirt Bomb.info: The Dirt Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but its explosion will place Dirt Blocks in open spaces, instead of destroying blocks. Existing blocks within the explosion radius will remain unaffected.

Discount Card.info: The Discount Card is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it reduces NPC shop buy prices, Nurse healing, and reforging prices by 1/5 (20%). The card must be equipped before talking to an NPC to enable discounts.

Diving Gear.info: The Diving Gear is an accessory that combines the functionality of the Flipper and Diving Helmet.

Diving Helmet.info: The Diving Helmet is an armor piece for the helmet slot. It has a 1/20 (5%) chance of being dropped by Sharks and Orcas. When equipped, it causes the breath meter to deplete much slower and slows the rate at which drowning damage is taken.

Drippler Crippler.info: The Drippler Crippler is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Blood Eels. When thrown, it fires a thorny ball from the flail's head, which deals 50% of the weapon's damage (55 base damage). Thorny balls are affected by gravity, can bounce off blocks twice, and pierce two enemies; dissipating upon hitting a block or enemy a third time, or when it stops rolling.

Druidic Serpent Cloak.info: The Druidic Serpent Cloak is a Hardmode accessory.

Dry Bomb.info: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks.

Dunerider Boots.info: The Dunerider Boots are an accessory that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the top 4/7ths of the Underground Desert, and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.

Durendal.info: The Durendal is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss whip.

Dye Vat.info: The Dye Vat is a crafting station used to craft dyes, paints, and colored string and Golf Balls. It is purchased from the Dye Trader for 5 Gold.

Dynamite.info: Dynamite is an explosive that explodes 5 seconds after being thrown. The explosion breaks nearly all blocks, background walls, and furniture within a radius of 7 tiles, except explosion-proof objects. The explosion also deals 250 damage to all enemies, critters, and players (but not NPCs) within 7.8 tiles  horizontally and vertically of the Dynamite. Dynamite works in liquids.

Dynasty Wood.info: Dynasty Wood is a type of wood purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 Copper per block. When placed, it forms continuous structures with automatic frames.

Ebonsand Block.info: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions. Sand can spread and be converted by the evil biomes and The Hallow (see below).

Ebonsandstone Block.info: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome.

Ebonstone Block.info: Ebonstone is a block type found in The Corruption. Before Hardmode, it is most prominent in the lining of Chasms. It requires at least 65% pickaxe power (Nightmare Pickaxe / Deathbringer Pickaxe, or better) or explosives to mine. Deathweed can grow on it.

Ebonwood.info: Ebonwood is a type of wood harvested from Ebonwood trees and Ebonwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Corruption biomes. Ebonwood trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Corrupt grass or Corrupt Jungle grass above surface, and Ebonwood Palm trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Ebonsand Blocks above surface.

Ebonwood Bow.info: The Ebonwood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Ebonwood Sword.info: The Ebonwood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Ectoplasm.info: Ectoplasm is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material dropped from Dungeon Spirits in the Dungeon. Dungeon Spirits drop 1–2 Ectoplasm upon death.

Electric Eel.info: The Electric Eel is a Hardmode whip that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron.

Electrosphere Launcher.info: The Electrosphere Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When used, it consumes rockets and fires blue missiles that form an Electrosphere upon impact with blocks, enemies, or reaching the cursor's position when fired. Electrospheres deal damage repeatedly and last for 5 seconds, but do not inflict any knockback. Multiple Electrospheres cannot overlap, with newly summoned ones replacing older ones.

Elf Melter.info: The Elf Melter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged weapon that uses Gel for ammunition. It is an indirect upgrade to the Flamethrower. When used, it consumes one Gel and releases five bursts of fire in quick succession. The fire expands as it travels, creating a cone-like area of effect, before dissipating shortly after. The fire has 15 armor penetration, inflicts the Frostbite debuff for 20 seconds, and can pierce through three enemies. The fire's damage decreases by 15% per enemy pierced.

Emerald.info: Emerald is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. It can craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and has no exclusive recipes.

Emerald Bunny.info: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.

Emerald Squirrel.info: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Emerald Staff.info: The Emerald Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a high-velocity green bolt which gradually slows down and then lingers in place. The green bolt can pierce once, and can stick to blocks and deal damage to enemies that walk into it. While moving, the green bolt also has a damaging trail that follows it, extending its hitbox. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).

Empress Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Enchanted Boomerang.info: The Enchanted Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang. It is a direct upgrade to the Wooden Boomerang.

Enchanted Sword.info: The Enchanted Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it occasionally fires an Enchanted Beam projectile that cannot pierce enemies or pass through blocks. Both the sword and its projectile produce lingering particles that emit large amounts of light.

Eventide.info: The Eventide is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bow that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. When used, it fires a burst of four arrows and one Twilight Lance projectile, with the Twilight Lance dealing 200% of the weapon's damage (110 base damage when using Wooden Arrows). It can also convert Wooden Arrows into Twilight Lances, which only deal 100% of the weapon's damage. The Twilight Lances are unaffected by gravity and can pierce four times, dissipating on the fifth hit.

Excalibur.info: The Excalibur is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss broadsword. When swung, a large yellow aura follows the swing, reaching about twice the distance of the sword itself. The aura can hit up to three enemies.

Exotic Scimitar.info: The Exotic Scimitar is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped from the Dye Trader. Striking enemies with the weapon increases its damage by 12% per hit, up to a maximum of 50%. This damage bonus decays at a rate of 0.5% per tick or 30% per second.

Explosive Trap Cane.info: The Explosive Trap Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Explosive Trap sentry causes an explosion when enemies are nearby. Explosive Traps do not disappear when exploding, and will remain until its duration has expired or when the Old One's Army event ends. The higher the tier, the more damage the Explosive Traps deal.

Explosive Trap Rod.info: The Explosive Trap Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Explosive Trap sentry causes an explosion when enemies are nearby. Explosive Traps do not disappear when exploding, and will remain until its duration has expired or when the Old One's Army event ends. The higher the tier, the more damage the Explosive Traps deal.

Explosive Trap Staff.info: The Explosive Trap Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Explosive Trap sentry causes an explosion when enemies are nearby. Explosive Traps do not disappear when exploding, and will remain until its duration has expired or when the Old One's Army event ends. The higher the tier, the more damage the Explosive Traps deal.

Extendo Grip.info: The Extendo Grip is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 Gold. While equipped, it increases placement range and tool range by 2 tiles vertically and 3 tiles horizontally.

Eye of the Golem.info: The Eye of the Golem is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that grants +10% critical strike chance. It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

FPV Goggles.info: The FPV Goggles are a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory purchased from the Cyborg for 10 Gold. It centers the screen on the Kwad Racer Drone or Wall Racer Car while one is active, allowing the player to fly the drone or drive the car without having to keep it within the screen, or to use it to scout out areas that are difficult to reach.

Fairy Boots.info: Fairy Boots are an accessory that are made from the Spectre Boots and Flower Boots at a Tinkerer's Workshop. They combine both effects into one pair of boots.

Fairy Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Falcon Blade.info: The Falcon Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 38/625 (6.08%) chance of being obtained from Iron Crates and a 299/5000 (5.98%) chance from Mythril Crates. Striking enemies with the weapon increases its damage by 12% per hit, up to a maximum of 50%. This damage bonus decays at a rate of 0.5% per tick or 30% per second.

Fallen Star.info: The Fallen Star is an item that randomly falls from the sky at night and disappears at dawn (4:30 AM). They can be used to craft Mana Crystals, which permanently increase a player's mana capacity by 20 points each. They are used in a variety of crafting recipes and as ammunition for the Star Cannon and Super Star Shooter. Fallen Stars can be stored in ammo slots.

Fart in a Balloon.info: The Fart in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Fart in a Jar and the Shiny Red Balloon. It boosts jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the player's first jump's height to ~10.5 tiles (~75% increase), and provides a double jump that can reach a height of 18.5 tiles, for a total of 29 tiles.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Fart in a Jar.info: The Fart in a Jar is an accessory that allows the player to perform a double jump, accompanied by a farting sound effect. The Fart jump goes 10.5 tiles into the air, totalling 16.5 tiles when put together with the first jump.

Fast Clock.info: The Fast Clock is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Slow debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Pixies, regular Mummies, and Wraiths.

Feather.info: The Feather is a common crafting material dropped frequently by Harpies. It is used in crafting the Featherfall and Gravitation Potions and once again becomes important in Hardmode for crafting the first tier of wings – Angel and Demon Wings.

Feral Claws.info: Feral Claws are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Jungle Crates, Bramble Crates, and Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle.

Festive Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Fetid Baghnakhs.info: The Fetid Baghnakhs are a Hardmode broadsword that have a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics. They have a very short range, but an exceptionally high attack speed.

Fin Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Finch Staff.info: The Finch Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Baby Finch minion. It flies towards enemies to deal contact damage. The Finch Staff has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being found in Living Wood Chests within Living Trees. Newly created Journey Mode characters spawn with a Finch Staff.

Fire Feather.info: The Fire Feather is a Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft the Flame Wings. It has a (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 1/50 (2%) / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 1/75 (1.33%) chance of being dropped by Red Devils in The Underworld after defeating any mechanical boss.

Fire Gauntlet.info: The Fire Gauntlet is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses accessory.

Firecracker.info: The Firecracker is a Hardmode whip that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh.

Fish Finder.info: The Fish Finder is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the weather, wind speed, moon phase, and the player's Fishing Power.

Fisherman's Pocket Guide.info: The Fisherman's Pocket Guide is an informational accessory that displays the player's current Fishing Power.

Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Fishron Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Flairon.info: The Flairon is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it swings like a thrown flail and releases non-piercing, homing bubbles.

Flairoon.info: The Flairon is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it swings like a thrown flail and releases non-piercing, homing bubbles.

Flamarang.info: The Flamarang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang and an upgrade to the Enchanted Boomerang. It has a 1/2 (50%) chance of inflicting the On Fire! debuff to enemies for 3 seconds on hit.

Flame Waker Boots.info: The Flame Waker Boots are a vanity accessory obtained by opening Obsidian Crates or Hellstone Crates, found by fishing in Lava. They cause the player’s feet to leave trails of fire while moving on blocks. They are entirely cosmetic and provide no functional benefit of their own.

Flame Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Flameburst Cane.info: The Flameburst Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Flameburst Tower shoots fireballs towards enemies, which explode on contact and have a chance to inflict the On Fire! or Hellfire debuff. Unlike other projectile sentries, the Flameburst Tower is unable to fire upward at an angle greater than 45°; thus it often ignores flying enemies. The higher the tier, the more damage the Flameburst Towers deal.

Flameburst Rod.info: The Flameburst Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Flameburst Tower shoots fireballs towards enemies, which explode on contact and have a chance to inflict the On Fire! or Hellfire debuff. Unlike other projectile sentries, the Flameburst Tower is unable to fire upward at an angle greater than 45°; thus it often ignores flying enemies. The higher the tier, the more damage the Flameburst Towers deal.

Flameburst Staff.info: The Flameburst Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Flameburst Tower shoots fireballs towards enemies, which explode on contact and have a chance to inflict the On Fire! or Hellfire debuff. Unlike other projectile sentries, the Flameburst Tower is unable to fire upward at an angle greater than 45°; thus it often ignores flying enemies. The higher the tier, the more damage the Flameburst Towers deal.

Flamelash.info: The Flamelash is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron wand. When used, it fires a fireball that follows the cursor when ⚒ Use / Attack key is held. If the ⚒ Use / Attack key is released mid-drag, the fireball will be fired in that direction. If the cursor is stationary on release, it is fired directly away from the player. Once it is released, the fireball homes in on nearby enemies and can pierce once, creating a small explosion upon contact with a block or second enemy.

Flamethrower.info: The Flamethrower is a Hardmode, post-Skeletron Prime ranged weapon that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it consumes one Gel and releases five bursts of fire in quick succession. The fire expands as it travels, creating a cone-like area of effect, before dissipating shortly after. The fire has 15 armor penetration, inflicts the Hellfire debuff for 20 seconds, and can pierce through three enemies. The fire's damage decreases by 15% per enemy pierced.

Flaming Mace.info: The Flaming Mace is a pre-Hardmode flail. It has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff on hit. While the player is in water or the flail's head is submerged, the fire is extinguished and the weapon effectively becomes a regular Mace.

Flare Gun.info: The Flare Gun is a weapon that is found randomly in Gold Chests underground. When used, it fires Flares, which provide light and stick to the blocks they hit.

Fledgling Wings.info: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically. They have a flight time of 0.42 seconds and a vertical speed multiplier of 150%.

Flesh Knuckles.info: The Flesh Knuckles are a Hardmode accessory that have a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics. While equipped, they increase the player's defense by 8 and aggro by 400.

Flint.info: The Flint is a Hardmode melee weapon. The weapon builds up charge while the ⚒ Use / Attack button is held down, and releasing the button swings it in an arc around the player, accompanied by a yellow aura that reaches further than the weapon itself and also covers behind the player. If the weapon builds up charge for at least 0.5 seconds, it begins to glow brighter and produces a charging sound, signifying that it is fully powered.

Flintlock Pistol.info: The Flintlock Pistol is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be bought from the Arms Dealer for 5 Gold.

Flinx Fur.info: Flinx Fur is a crafting material dropped by Snow Flinx, an enemy found in the Ice biome. They drop 1–2 / 1–3 Flinx Fur.

Flinx Staff.info: The Flinx Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Flinx minion. It runs towards enemies, bouncing upwards upon contact before attempting to hit its target again. Its rapid attack rate also allows its bouncing to keep it airborne atop slow flying enemies.

Flipper.info: The Flipper is an accessory that allows a player to swim in liquids. When equipped, the player can swim upwards in any liquid by holding or pressing ↷ Jump repeatedly – essentially allowing unlimited multi-jumps while within liquid. It can be found in Water Chests and Ocean/Seaside Crates.

Flower Boots.info: Flower Boots are a rare accessory which cause flowers to grow when the player walks on regular, Jungle, Hallowed, and Ash grass. These flowers are functionally the same as the wild grass plants that grow naturally on grass, and drop Seeds and Hay normally.

Flower Pow.info: The Flower Pow is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Plantera. When thrown, it rapidly fires pink flower petals at nearby enemies, which deal 33.33% of the weapon's damage (43 base damage) and inflict 50% of its knockback (base knockback of 3.25 (Weak)).

Flower of Fire.info: The Flower of Fire is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron wand that fires a slow, non-piercing fireball that can bounce off blocks up to five times. The fireball dissipates upon contact with an enemy, with a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for a duration of 5 seconds. The Flower of Fire has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from Shadow Chests in The Underworld, and has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian and Hellstone Crates.

Flower of Frost.info: The Flower of Frost is a Hardmode wand that has a 19/80 (23.75%) chance of being dropped by Ice Mimics. When used, it fires a non-piercing ball of frost that can bounce off blocks up to seven times, dissipating on its eighth impact. The ball of frost inflicts the Frostbite debuff for 8 seconds on hit.

Flurry Boots.info: The Flurry Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, as well as in Frozen(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Boreal Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

Flying Carpet.info: The Flying Carpet is a flight accessory that allows the player to float for 5 seconds, similar to the Hoverboard. It can be found inside Chests located within Pyramids in the Desert. It can also be obtained by throwing a Pharaoh's Robe into Shimmer.

Flying Dragon.info: The Flying Dragon is a Hardmode, post-Golem broadsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When swung, it fires red crescent-shaped projectiles every 20 ticks, which pierce four enemies, pass through blocks, and dissipate after one second.

Flying Knife.info: The Flying Knife is a Hardmode melee weapon that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it fires a controllable knife. Holding the ⚒ Use / Attack button directs the projectile's general path, although it also continuously moves on its own and ricochets off blocks. When the ⚒ Use / Attack button is released or after one minute of continuous use, the knife returns to the player.

Flymeal.info: The Flymeal is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. Like the Classy Cane, it has the special ability to attack town NPCs. Flymeal completely ignores the defense of NPCs, and does 2× damage to them (30 base damage; 4× damage or 60 base damage to the Nurse instead). It also inflicts the Stinky debuff for 5 seconds.

FoodBarbarian's Tattered Dragon Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Forbidden Fragment.info: The Forbidden Fragment is a Hardmode crafting material which is always dropped by Sand Elementals, which spawn during Sandstorms in the Desert. To craft all items that require this material, 9 Forbidden Fragments are required.

Format:C.info: The Format:C is a Hardmode yoyo. It has a base 24% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%, and deals 250% damage on critical hits, as opposed to the usual 200%.

Foxparks.info: Foxparks is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Foxparks minion. It does not deal contact damage, but runs and shoots fireballs towards enemies that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 5–10 seconds. When the weapon is held down using ⚒ Use / Attack, Foxparks will teleport to the player and be held while using a special flamethrower attack that does not consume any ammunition. The flamethrower attack rapidly shoots flames that inflict the On Fire!

Freeze Bomb.info: The Freeze Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but its explosion will convert water to Ice Blocks, instead of destroying blocks. The Freeze Bomb has a fuse timer of 3 seconds and its explosion deals only 1 damage to the player who threw it, but no damage to enemies, critters and NPCs.

Frog Flipper.info: The Frog Flipper is an accessory crafted from a Frog Leg and a Flipper. It combines the abilities of these two items, increasing the player's jump speed and safe falling distance, allowing auto-jump, and giving the player the ability to swim.

Frog Gear.info: The Frog Gear is an accessory that combines the effects of the Frog Leg, Flipper, and Tiger Climbing Gear.

Frog Leg.info: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water.

Frog Webbing.info: The Frog Webbing is an accessory crafted from a Frog Leg and a Tiger Climbing Gear. It combines the abilities of these two items, increasing the player's jump speed and safe falling distance, allowing auto-jump, and granting enhanced mobility on walls.

Frost Core.info: The Frost Core is a Hardmode crafting material that is always dropped from Ice Golems, which spawn during Blizzards in the Snow biome. To craft all items that require this material, 5 Frost Cores are required.

Frost Daggerfish.info: The Frost Daggerfish is a consumable ranged weapon. It can hit up to 3 targets. Depending to player's final Fishing Power, from 7 to 137 Frost Daggerfish can be fished from lakes in Snow biomes at a time. When thrown, the Frost Daggerfish acts similarly to Shurikens or Throwing Knives, flying in an arc and then spinning to the ground, where they break upon impact.

Frost Staff.info: The Frost Staff is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by Icy Mermen and Ice Elementals. When used, it fires a frost bolt that pierces one enemy and does not pass through blocks. The Frost Staff also inflicts the Frostbite debuff for 7 seconds on hit.

Frostbrand.info: The Frostbrand is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 19/80 (23.75%) chance of being dropped by Ice Mimics. When swung, it fires a Frost Bolt projectile that pierces two enemies before dissipating on the third hit, cannot pass through blocks, and inflicts the Frostbite debuff for 4 seconds on hit.

Frostspark Boots.info: The Frostspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory crafted from Lightning Boots and Ice Skates, and combines their functionality.

Frozen Shield.info: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post-Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell.

Frozen Turtle Shell.info: The Frozen Turtle Shell is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by Ice Tortoises. While equipped, it grants the Ice Barrier buff, which provides +25% damage reduction while the player's health is at or below 50%. While the effect is active, it displays as a blue circle spinning around the player.

Frozen Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Fruitcake Chakram.info: The Fruitcake Chakram is a pre-Hardmode boomerang dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 0.626% in pre-Hardmode and 0.584% in Hardmode.

Furnace.info: The Furnace is a crafting station used mainly to smelt ores into bars and create various pieces of furniture. It is also a light source, but it is not valid for housing. The Furnace smelts all pre-Hardmode ores besides Hellstone, which must be smelted in a Hellforge. The Glass Kiln, Hellforge, and Hardmode Forges are upgraded versions of the Furnace, each with additional crafting recipes.

GPS.info: The GPS is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, the player's horizontal position, and their depth.

Gatligator.info: The Gatligator is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 35 Gold. When used, it rapidly fires bullets in a roughly 30° spread, at a varying velocity. It also has a 50% chance not to consume ammunition.

Gel.info: Gel is a common crafting material dropped by most slimes and Slimed Zombies. Gel is vital due to it being an ingredient in Torches, and is used regularly from the beginning stages all the way through to endgame scenarios. It is also used as ammunition for the Flamethrower and the Elf Melter, and can therefore be stored in the player's ammo slots.

Ghastly Glaive.info: The Ghastly Glaive is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss spear that is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/10 (10%) chance / 1/5 (20%) chance during Tier 2, and a 1/20 (5%) chance during Tier 3. Unlike any other spear, it is thrust in a curved motion. Upon striking an enemy, a yellow ghast projectile appears next to a random nearby enemy and flies in a straight line through it for 1 second before dissipating.

Ghostar's Infinity Eight.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Giant Harpy Feather.info: The Giant Harpy Feather is a rare crafting material used solely to craft Harpy Wings. It has a 1/150 (0.67%) chance of being dropped by Harpies.

Glacier Fang.info: The Glacier Fang is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires chargeable icicles toward the cursor, affected by gravity. It can be found in Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, Frozen Crates, and Boreal Crates.

Gladius.info: The Gladius is a pre-Hardmode shortsword that is dropped by Hoplites with a 1/20 (5%) chance. It attacks three times in quick succession per use, with slightly varying angles with each stab.

Glass.info: Glass is crafted from different types of sand at a Furnace. Glass can be placed as a block and is an ingredient in producing various items.

Glowing Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Glowing Mushroom.info: The Glowing Mushroom is a plant, crafting material, and block that can be found on Mushroom grass in the Glowing Mushroom biome. Glowing Mushroom plants emit blue light.

Goblin Tech.info: The Goblin Tech is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the most valuable block nearby, the player's current DPS, and their current movement speed.

Gold Bar.info: The Gold Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Gold Bow.info: The Gold Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Gold Broadsword.info: The Gold Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Gold Shortsword.

Gold Ore.info: Gold Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Gold Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Gold Ring.info: The Gold Ring is a Hardmode accessory that greatly increases the pickup range for coins. It has a 1/500 (0.2%) chance to be dropped by pirates (except Parrots) during Pirate Invasions, with a 1/125 (0.8%) chance from the Pirate Captain. It also has a 1/15 (6.67%) chance to be dropped by the Flying Dutchman(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).

Gold Shortsword.info: The Gold Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Gold Broadsword.

Gold Watch.info: Watches are informational accessories that show the current in-game time in the top-right corner of the screen.

Golden Shower.info: The Golden Shower is a Hardmode spell book that fires arcing golden ichor streams in quick succession. Each stream can hit up to 5 targets. The streams inflict the Ichor debuff for 10 seconds (15 seconds in PvP), which adds 15 armor penetration.

Golem Fist.info: The Golem Fist is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem. When used, it fires a large, high-velocity fist attached to a chain that retracts on impact with enemies or blocks, or after traveling for more than 31.25 tiles away from the player.. Upon hitting enemies or blocks, it creates a shockwave that deals 100% of the weapon's damage and knockback to nearby enemies if extended by more than 9.375 tiles.

Gradient.info: The Gradient is a Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 20 Gold. It leaves behind a visual gradient trail when used.

Gravedigger's Shovel.info: The Gravedigger's Shovel is a tool that can be used to dig up "soft" blocks (see below) more efficiently than a pickaxe or drill, in a 3×3-tile rectangle centered on the cursor.

recipes.station: Iron Anvil / Lead Anvil + Ecto Mist

Gravity Globe.info: The Gravity Globe is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord accessory that allows the holder to flip gravity, so that the player falls up instead of down, and toggle gravity back to normal afterward. Once equipped, pressing the ▲ Up key toggles the gravity direction. This only affects the player with the item equipped. The Gravity Globe is always dropped from the Moon Lord's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Gray Zapinator.info: The Gray Zapinator is a pre-Hardmode-exclusive magic gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 17 Gold. It is only available once King Slime, the Eye of Cthulhu, Eater of Worlds, Brain of Cthulhu, Queen Bee, Deerclops, or Skeletron has been defeated. Its Hardmode counterpart is the Orange Zapinator.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Greedy Ring.info: The Greedy Ring is a Hardmode accessory that combines the Discount Card's 20% discount off at any NPC shop, the Lucky Coin's 20% chance of spawning 1–10 extra coins whenever an enemy is hit and +0.05 luck, and the Gold Ring's increased coin pickup range.

Green Counterweight.info: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player. Counterweights deal the yoyo's full damage and stay active until the yoyo is retracted towards the player. There are six different color variants with identical functionalities.

Green Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Green Horseshoe Balloon.info: The Green Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33%, jump speed by 30%, grants a double jump, and grants +0.05 luck. The height of the first jump is increased from 6 blocks to 10.5 blocks (~75% increase), while the double jump's height is increased from 10.5 blocks to 18.5 blocks, reaching a total of 29 blocks with both jumps. The double jump also makes a fart sound.

Green Mushroom.info: The Green Mushroom is a type of mushroom. It grows on Dirt, Stone, Mud, or regular Jungle grass in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Green Dye.

Green Phaseblade.info: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them. They can be recalled by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again, which will damage enemies along the way. They can also be recalled mid-throw.

Green Phasesaber.info: Phasesabers are a group of Hardmode broadswords, direct upgrades to the phaseblades with much more damage and slightly faster use time. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them.

Green Rocket.info: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 Silver each.

Green String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Grenade.info: The Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon which can be purchased from the Demolitionist for 75 Copper each, or found rarely in natural Chests and, once Hardmode is activated, in Pots (replacing Shurikens).

Grenade Launcher.info: The Grenade Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher. When used, it consumes rockets and launches grenades that explode after three seconds have passed or upon contact with enemies. The grenades are strongly affected by gravity and can damage the player for a flat 60 damage.

Grox The Great's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Guide Voodoo Doll.info: The Guide Voodoo Doll is a boss-summoning item used to summon the Wall of Flesh. It is a guaranteed drop from Voodoo Demons, a fairly rare enemy in the Underworld.

Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage.info: The Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage is an accessory that, when equipped, causes destroyed vines to drop Vine Ropes. It has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being found in surface Chests, or a 1/120 (0.83%) chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing. It can also be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 2 Gold 50 Silver during First Quarter moons.

Gungnir.info: The Gungnir is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss spear. When thrust, it creates a small shockwave at its tip.

Hallowed Bar.info: The Hallowed Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Hallowed Jousting Lance.info: The Hallowed Jousting Lance is a Hardmode melee weapon. When attacking using ⚒ Use / Attack, the lance will extend, and holding ⚒ Use / Attack will keep it extended at a fixed angle. The damage and knockback will increase depending on the player's movement speed, making mounts, sprinting accessories, or dash abilities (such as those granted by Shield of Cthulhu, Tabi/Master Ninja Gear, or Solar Flare armor) useful for maximizing damage.

Hallowed Repeater.info: The Hallowed Repeater is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss repeater.

Hallowed Seeds.info: Hallowed Seeds are Hardmode seeds used to plant Hallowed grass on Dirt Blocks, which will then spread The Hallow. Hallowed Seeds are purchased from the Dryad in Hardmode for 20 Silver each.

Ham Bat.info: The Ham Bat is a Hardmode broadsword that deals slightly more damage while a food buff is active (see Notes for details) and grants increased health regeneration on kill.

Hand Of Creation.info: The Hand Of Creation is a post-Skeletron construction accessory.

Hand Warmer.info: The Hand Warmer is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Chilled and Frozen debuffs. It is obtained from Presents, with a chance of about 0.622% in pre-Hardmode and about 0.580% in Hardmode.

Handgun.info: The Handgun is a pre-Hardmode gun that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and from Golden Lock Boxes found in Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates.

Happy Grenade.info: The Happy Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon that inflicts half the damage of an ordinary Grenade and displays a confetti effect. They must be acquired initially from being dropped by the Party Girl when she is killed, although she only has 1/4 (25%) chance of dropping them each time she is killed. Once the Party Girl respawns again, they can be purchased from her for 2 Silver 50 Copper each, while the player has them in their inventory.

Hardened Crimsand Block.info: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Hardened Ebonsand Block.info: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Hardened Pearlsand Block.info: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Hardened Sand Block.info: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome. It looks similar to Sand Blocks, with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity.

Harp.info: The Harp is a Hardmode crafting material, used only to craft the Magical Harp. While the Harp can be used itself, it has no functional use, and only makes sounds. It is sold by the Wizard for 1 Gold each.

Harpoon.info: The Harpoon is a unique pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that auto-fires an arcing spear projectile connected to the player via a chain that pierces through enemies and inflicts the Bleeding debuff for 8–12 seconds on hit. It retracts if it hits a third enemy, collides with solid blocks, has traveled for more than 62.5 tiles away from the player, or if the player lets go of the ⚒ Use / Attack button. Its physics are similar to launched flails, though it is highly affected by gravity.

Harpy Charm.info: The Harpy Charm is a pre-Hardmode combat accessory that grants +5% ranged critical strike chance and redirects arrows fired by the player towards the closest enemy. Arrows must be at least 25 tiles away from the player in order to be redirected. After the Harpy Charm redirects an arrow, it goes on cooldown for 1.5 seconds, during which the effect will not occur.

Harpy Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Heat Ray.info: The Heat Ray is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem. When used, it fires yellow lasers that instantly travel their maximum distance. The lasers do not pierce enemies.

Heavy Sling.info: The Heavy Sling is a Hardmode accessory that has a 19/80 (23.75%) chance of dropping from Ice Mimics. While equipped, it allows the player to pick up a sentry when coming in contact with it, causing the sentry to attach itself to the player and move with them while still performing its usual attacks. The player cannot drop a sentry after picking it up, but can despawn it by using ⚷ Open / Activate on the sentry, by unequipping the Heavy Sling, or by summoning another sentry when not having enough sentry slots.

Hel-Fire.info: The Hel-Fire is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by any enemy in or near The Underworld. It inflicts the Hellfire debuff for 3–8 seconds upon hit.

Helium Moss.info: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Helium Moss Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Hellfire Treads.info: The Hellfire Treads are a pre-Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Spectre and Flame Waker Boots. It grants the player the ability to fly and to gain increased movement speed when running continuously, and causes the player's feet to leave trails of fire while moving on blocks, which is a purely visual effect.

Hellforge.info: The Hellforge is a crafting station that functions as a regular Furnace, with the additional ability of smelting Hellstone into Hellstone Bars. It is also used to craft the essential Adamantite/Titanium Forge in Hardmode. Like its predecessor, it emits light when placed and is not a valid light source for housing.
