Hellstone.info: Hellstone is a pre-Hardmode ore that can be found in The Underworld. Mining it requires at least a Nightmare/Deathbringer Pickaxe, and it cannot be mined with explosives in pre-Hardmode. Hellstone releases a half-tile of lava when mined in The Underworld.

Hellstone Bar.info: The Hellstone Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar. It is used to craft some of the most powerful equipment available pre-Hardmode, and remains useful, if not necessary, in dealing with the shift in difficulty upon entering Hardmode. Notably, the Molten Pickaxe is the only pre-Hardmode pickaxe capable of mining the first tier of Hardmode ores, Cobalt and Palladium.

Hellwing Bow.info: The Hellwing Bow is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron bow that fires arrows inaccurately. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into flaming bat projectiles that are unaffected by gravity, can pierce infinitely, and cannot pass through blocks. The Hellwing Bow has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates.

Hercules Beetle.info: The Hercules Beetle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that increases the damage of summon weapons by 15% and increases their knockback by 2. The Hercules Beetle can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for 40 Gold if he is spoken to in the Jungle after Plantera has been defeated.

Hermes Boots.info: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

Hero Shield.info: The Hero Shield is a Hardmode post-Plantera shield accessory that redirects 25% of damage from players on the same team while above 25% health, similar to the effect of the Paladin's Shield. Furthermore, it increases defense by 10, increases aggro by 400, and grants immunity to knockback.

Heroicis' Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Heroicis' Wings (Inactive).info: Heroicis' Wings (Inactive) are a crafting material used solely to craft Heroicis' Wings. They can be obtained along with the rest of Heroicis' set by throwing a Platinum Coin into water in an Oasis.

High Test Fishing Line.info: The High Test Fishing Line is an accessory that prevents fishing line from breaking while fishing when equipped. Without the High Test Fishing Line equipped, there is a 1/7 (14.29%) chance that the line will break on any reel-in that was supposed to yield a catch. The High Test Fishing Line can be acquired as a 1/34 (2.94%) chance reward for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC, depending on the number of completed quests and other factors (see Angler § Quest rewards for details).

Hive Pack.info: The Hive Pack is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Queen Bee's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants a 1/2 (50%) chance of replacing friendly Bee projectiles with stronger Giant Bees.

Hive-Five.info: The Hive-Five is a pre-Hardmode yoyo. Upon enemy hits, it has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of summoning a homing Bee projectile. The Bee projectile deals 50% of the weapon's damage (12 base damage), has a 1/2 (50%) chance to deal 1 extra damage, can pierce enemies or bounce off blocks up to 3 times, and lasts for 10 seconds.

Holy Water.info: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome (Hallow, Corruption, or Crimson for Holy Water, Unholy Water, and Blood Water respectively) when thrown. This conversion affects a roughly circular area with a radius of four tiles from the center. Enemies within this radius are also damaged slightly; this damage is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment.

Honey Balloon.info: The Honey Balloon is an accessory that combines the functions of a Shiny Red Balloon and a Honey Comb. It boosts jump height by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the player's jump height to ~10½ blocks (~75% increase), while oddly reducing it when underwater, from 8 blocks-to 7 blocks, and releases a small swarm of angry bees when the player is hurt, which seek out and deal small amounts of damage to enemies.

Honey Bomb.info: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks.

Honey Comb.info: The Honey Comb is a pre-Hardmode accessory which has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to be dropped by the Queen Bee. When equipped, it spawns 1–4 Bee projectiles which attack nearby enemies each time the player takes damage, and grants the Honey buff for 5 seconds after being damaged.

Hornet Staff.info: The Hornet Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Hornet minion. It hovers above enemies, firing stingers that inflict the Poisoned debuff for 4–7 seconds and do not pierce.

Houndius Shootius.info: The Houndius Shootius is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Houndius Shootius sentry. It shoots fireballs towards enemies, which dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks. The Houndius Shootius has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Deerclops.

Hoverboard.info: The Hoverboard is a Hardmode wing-type accessory. It functions like a regular pair of wings, but with the added ability to hover by holding ↷ Jump and ▼ Down.

Huntress's Buckler.info: The Huntress's Buckler is a Hardmode shield accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%. The Huntress's Buckler is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event with a 1/6 (16.67%) / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 2, and a 1/12 (8.33%) chance during Tier 3.

Ice Blade.info: The Ice Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that is found in Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, Frozen Crates, and Boreal Crates. When swung, it occasionally fires an Ice Bolt projectile that deals the weapon's damage and does not pass through blocks or pierce enemies. The Ice Blade also has a base 6% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%.

Ice Block.info: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes. They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill. Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them.

Ice Boomerang.info: The Ice Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that has a 15.52% chance of being found inside Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, as well as a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being obtained from Frozen and Boreal Crates. It can also inflict the Frostburn debuff for 3 seconds, and also has a base 6% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%.

Ice Bow.info: The Ice Bow is a Hardmode bow that has a 19/80 (23.75%) chance of being dropped by Ice Mimics. When used, it converts any type of arrow into high-velocity Frost Arrows. Unlike the Frostburn Arrow item, they do not inflict the Frostburn debuff.

Ice Feather.info: The Ice Feather is a Hardmode crafting material used solely to craft Frozen Wings. The Ice Feather has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by Ice Golems during a Blizzard in the Snow biome.

Ice Rod.info: The Ice Rod is a Hardmode magic weapon that autofires blocks of ice, which have the unique ability of placing solid, temporary  Ice Blocks at the location of the cursor and which last for 15 seconds before shattering. These Ice Blocks are translucent, cast a dim, flickering blue light, and are slippery like normal Ice Blocks. The Ice Rod can be purchased from the Wizard for 50 Gold.

Ice Sickle.info: The Ice Sickle is a Hardmode broadsword that can be dropped with a 1/100 (1%) chance by Armored Vikings, Ice Elementals, Ice Tortoises, and Icy Mermen. When swung, it fires a spinning blue sickle projectile that deals 67% of the weapon's damage (33 base damage) and can pierce up to 4 enemies. The sickle gradually slows down after being fired, dissipating after traveling for 3 seconds.

Ice Skates.info: Ice Skates are a pre-Hardmode accessory that improves a player's movement control on Thin Ice, all Ice Blocks, Ice Rod blocks, Frozen Slime Blocks and Aetherium Blocks. The player accelerates faster, slides shorter distances, and will no longer cause Thin Ice to break when landing from falls or jumps.

Ice Torch.info: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the Throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 Copper each.

Ichor.info: Ichor is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Ichor Stickers in the Underground Crimson and the Tainted Ghoul in the Crimson Underground Desert. It is also obtained from Hematic Crates. It is used to craft many Ichor-related items. It is the Crimson counterpart to the Corruption's Cursed Flame.

Illegal Gun Parts.info: Illegal Gun Parts are a crafting material used to craft the Sandgun, the Megashark, and the Flamethrower. They are sold by the Arms Dealer for 20 Gold at night.

Imp Staff.info: The Imp Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Flying Imp minion. It hovers near enemies, shooting fireballs that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds and can pierce up to 4 times, dissipating on the 5th hit.

Inferno Fork.info: The Inferno Fork is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 (5%) / 39/400 (9.75%) chance of being dropped by Diabolists in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires a fireball that causes a lingering explosion upon contact with an enemy or a block. The explosion hits repeatedly, dealing 75% of the weapon's damage (52 base damage). The fireball and the explosion also inflict the Hellfire debuff for 8–15 seconds.

Influx Waver.info: The Influx Waver is a Hardmode, post-Golem broadsword that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When swung, it fires a blue sword projectile. Upon contact with enemies, the sword projectile will teleport onto nearby enemies two times, hitting three times in total.

Inner Tube.info: The Inner Tube is an accessory that has a 9/40 (22.5%) chance of being found in Water Chests, Ocean Crates, and Seaside Crates. When equipped, it causes the player to float on the surface of liquids instead of sinking to the bottom and gives +5 Fishing Power. This effect can be temporarily negated by holding ▼ Down. Additionally, when the player is in any liquid, the Inner Tube also grants the player the Flipper's effect (press ↷ Jump to swim upwards).

Iron Anvil.info: The Iron Anvil and Lead Anvil are pre-Hardmode crafting stations used mainly to craft weapons and armor. Both anvils can craft the same items. Most of their recipes require metal bars, although they are also used to make other items, such as the Jungle tier of equipment. An anvil is a vital crafting station for most of the game, as it is used to make items from every tier up to Cobalt and Palladium, after which it must be replaced by a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil.

Iron Bar.info: The Iron Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Iron Bow.info: The Iron Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Iron Broadsword.info: The Iron Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Iron Shortsword.

Iron Ore.info: Iron Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Iron Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes. It can be obtained from all types of crates.

Iron Shortsword.info: The Iron Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Iron Broadsword. In Journey Mode, the Iron Shortsword replaces the Copper Shortsword for newly created characters.

Jack 'O Lantern Launcher.info: The Jack 'O Lantern Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that consumes Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns as ammunition. Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns bounce off blocks before exploding upon contact with an enemy or after 5 seconds. The Jack 'O Lantern Launcher has a base 10% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Javelin.info: The Javelin is a consumable ranged weapon that are dropped by Hoplites, which have a 1/2 (50%) chance to drop 40–80 Javelins. When used, it flies straight for approximately 36 tiles before dropping abruptly. It can hit up to 3 targets.

Jellyfish Diving Gear.info: Jellyfish Diving Gear is an accessory crafted by combining Jellyfish Necklace and Diving Gear at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Jellyfish Necklace.info: The Jellyfish Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/100 (1%) chance to drop from Pink, Blue, or Green Jellyfish in the Ocean and Underground or Cavern layer. In the  Old-gen console version and Nintendo 3DS version, the Jellyfish Necklace provides a faint pink glow when the player is submerged in water or honey. In the  Desktop version,  Console version, and  Mobile version, this glow is also provided out of liquids and its brightness is significantly increased when submerged.

Jetpack.info: The Jetpack is a Hardmode wing-type accessory obtainable after defeating any mechanical boss. Like all wings, it grants the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, it allows traveling at 33 mph horizontally and 38 mph vertically. It has a flight time of 2.5 seconds and a vertical speed multiplier of 150%.

Jim's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Jousting Lance.info: The Jousting Lance is a Hardmode melee weapon purchased from the Zoologist for 6 Gold after filling out 30% (164 entries) of the Bestiary. When attacking using ⚒ Use / Attack, the lance will extend, and holding ⚒ Use / Attack will keep it extended at a fixed angle.

Jungle Grass Seeds.info: Jungle Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant Jungle grass in Mud Blocks, which can potentially create an artificial Jungle or Underground Jungle (depending on depth) if enough Jungle grass and plants are created. Jungle Grass Seeds can be found by cutting down plants growing on Jungle grass using virtually any tool or weapon. They can also be obtained from putting Poo into an Extractinator, with an 1/150 (0.67%) chance per item.

Jungle Spores.info: Jungle Spores are crafting materials acquired by destroying green glowing orbs that grow randomly on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle, in or below the Cavern layer. Each orb drops 2–3 Jungle Spores. Harvested Jungle Spores cannot be replanted.

KO Cannon.info: The KO Cannon is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Clowns. When used, it fires a boxing glove attached to the player via a chain. The glove retracts on contact with blocks or enemies, or after traveling 12 tiles.

Kaleidoscope.info: The Kaleidoscope is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light.

Katana.info: The Katana is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 Gold. The Katana has a base 19% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Kazzymodus' Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Keg.info: The Keg is a crafting station used solely to brew Ale. In addition to being crafted, it can sometimes be found in Underground Cabins.

Keybrand.info: The Keybrand is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that has a 1/200 (0.5%) / 399/40,000 (0.9975%) chance of being dropped by Blue Armored Bones, Hell Armored Bones, and Rusty Armored Bones in the Hardmode Dungeon. It deals increased damage against enemies depending on their missing health, up to a maximum of 200% damage against enemies that have less than 10% health remaining. The Keybrand also has a 20% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Killing Deck.info: The Killing Deck is a Hardmode magic weapon that can be purchased from the Wizard for 20 Gold during a Blood Moon. It launches Killing Card projectiles that fly for 0.5 seconds in a serpentine pattern before abruptly falling. They stick to any block or enemy they hit, but stop dealing damage after becoming stuck, and return to the player 5 seconds after the impact.

Kinship Peach.info: The Kinship Peach is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss crafting material, which is notably crafted using Life Fruit. It is used to upgrade Cattiva and Foxparks to their "trusty" variants.

Kraken.info: The Kraken is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance to drop from Duke Fishron. It has a base 14% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Krypton Moss.info: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Krypton Moss Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Land Mine.info: The Land Mine is a unique Hardmode, post-Plantera placeable item. They remain dormant once placed, until an entity touches them or they are activated by Wire, at which point they explode, dealing 250 base damage to all entities within a 8×8-tile area. The only tile destroyed by the explosion is the activated landmine itself.

Laser Machinegun.info: The Laser Machinegun is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic gun that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When used, it fires two inaccurate blue lasers that do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks. The weapon accelerates while the ⚒ Use / Attack button is held down, reaching its maximum fire rate after nearly two seconds of continuous usage.

Laser Rifle.info: The Laser Rifle is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When used, it fires fast-moving purple lasers that can hit up to three enemies. The lasers will increase in damage, pierce, knockback, and size (only visually) as they travel. While a full set of Meteor armor is equipped, the Laser Rifle costs no mana to use.

Last Prism.info: The Last Prism is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord magic weapon that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it projects six rainbow-colored beams each dealing the weapon's listed damage, which immediately begin to rotate and converge into one concentrated beam over a duration of 3 seconds. The fully-converged beam instead deals 300% of the weapon's damage (300 base damage) per hit. While held, the Last Prism's aim works in a sweeping motion, meaning the turn rate is reduced.

Lava Bomb.info: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks.

Lava Charm.info: The Lava Charm is an accessory that grants immunity to lava for 7 seconds. It is found in Chests located in the cavern layer as well as obtained from Hellstone Crates and Obsidian Crates with a 1/20 (5%) chance. It can only be found in Chests in the lower portion of the Caverns where lava pools can naturally spawn, as opposed to Chests throughout the entirety of the Caverns.

Lava Moss.info: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Lava Moss Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Lava Waders.info: The Lava Waders are a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory.

Lavaproof Fishing Hook.info: The Lavaproof Fishing Hook is an accessory that allows the player to fish in lava with any bait and any fishing pole. It has a 19/100 (19%) chance of being obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates, both of which can be obtained from fishing in lava.

Lavaproof Tackle Bag.info: The Lavaproof Tackle Bag is an accessory that combines the functionalities of its components: the Angler Earring's 10% boost to Fishing Power, the Tackle Box's chance not to consume bait, the unbreakable quality of the High Test Fishing Line, and the ability to fish in lava from the Lavaproof Fishing Hook.

Lazure's Barrier Platform.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Lead Bar.info: The Lead Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Lead Bow.info: The Lead Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Lead Broadsword.info: The Lead Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Lead Shortsword.

Lead Ore.info: Lead Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Lead Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Lead Shortsword.info: The Lead Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Lead Broadsword.

Leaf Blower.info: The Leaf Blower is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it rapidly fires a spread of leaf projectiles that begin swirling after traveling for about 15 tiles, and move in a spiral circle pattern while gradually fading away. The leaves cannot pass through blocks or pierce enemies.

Leaf Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Leather Whip.info: The Leather Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip that is virtually always available to be purchased from the Zoologist for 5 Gold (save for certain scenarios). It has a 50% multihit penalty, and inflicts 4 tag damage on enemies.

Leinfors' Prehensile Cloak.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Lens.info: A Lens is a common crafting material that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to drop from Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes.

Lesser Healing Potion.info: The  Lesser Healing Potion is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that restores 50 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the first tier of healing potion, preceding the Healing Potion, Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

Lesser Mana Potion.info: The Lesser Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 50 mana when used and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It can be purchased from the Merchant for 1 Silver each, and can also be found in Wooden and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing.

Life Crystal.info: The Life Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's health capacity by 20, adding a red heart to the player's health bar, while also restoring 20 health.

Life Drain.info: The Life Drain is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics. When used, it creates an invisible aura that deals continuous damage to all enemies near the cursor's position, as long as the line of sight between the player and the cursor is unobstructed. A stream of red particles flows toward the player from each targeted enemy.

Life Fruit.info: The Life Fruit is a Hardmode plant and permanent booster item that grows on Jungle grass in any area within the Underground layer or below, and only after any mechanical boss has been defeated. Life Fruit grow 25% faster on average in Expert Mode.

Lifeform Analyzer.info: The Lifeform Analyzer is an informational accessory that displays the name of rare enemies, critters, and undiscovered NPCs (see list below) within 81.25 tiles around the player.

Light Disc.info: The Light Disc is a Hardmode, post-The Destroyer boomerang. It does not necessarily return immediately upon contact with objects, but instead can bounce off blocks before returning. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of six Light Discs that can be thrown out at one time.

Light Shard.info: The Light Shard is a Hardmode crafting material used in the crafting of the Dao of Pow, Sky Fracture and Ruinous Staff. It has a 1/10 (10%) chance to drop from Light Mummies and Spectral Mummies (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) which spawn in Hallowed deserts.

Light's Bane.info: The Light's Bane is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates a dark slash near the tip of the sword. The slashes deal 50% of the weapon's damage (8 base damage) and its full knockback, have 5 armor penetration, pierce once, and will automatically target enemies within a radius of 3.125 tiles. The weapon also has a chance to create a big slash that is twice as large and deals 100% of the weapon's damage. The chance of big slashes occurring is equal to the player's melee critical strike chance.

Lightning Aura Cane.info: The Lightning Aura Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Lightning Aura sentry consists of an aura with a radius of 9 tiles, which damages enemies repeatedly while within. For enemies with less than 999 defense, Lightning Aura sentries have armor penetration equal to their defense, completely bypassing it. The higher the tier, the more damage the Lightning Auras deal.

Lightning Aura Rod.info: The Lightning Aura Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Lightning Aura sentry consists of an aura with a radius of 9 tiles, which damages enemies repeatedly while within. For enemies with less than 999 defense, Lightning Aura sentries have armor penetration equal to their defense, completely bypassing it. The higher the tier, the more damage the Lightning Auras deal.

Lightning Aura Staff.info: The Lightning Aura Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Lightning Aura sentry consists of an aura with a radius of 9 tiles, which damages enemies repeatedly while within. For enemies with less than 999 defense, Lightning Aura sentries have armor penetration equal to their defense, completely bypassing it. The higher the tier, the more damage the Lightning Auras deal.

Lightning Boots.info: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots.

Lightning Strike.info: The Lightning Strike is a Hardmode wand. It fires a spark that attaches itself to an enemy and calls down a lightning bolt from the sky to its location shortly after. Similarly to natural lightning during a Thunderstorm, it damages all enemies in its path and electrifies liquids it strikes in. The weapon has a base 14% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Lime Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Lime Kelp.info: The Lime Kelp is a dye material and type of plant. It grows on any tiles submerged in at least 2 tiles of any liquid in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Lime Dye.

Lime String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Living Wood Wand.info: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana. Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below). There are 6 different block-placing wands.

Loki's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Loom.info: The Loom is a crafting station used to craft Silk, as well as some items that require Silk as an ingredient. It can sometimes be found in Underground Cabins.

Lucky Coin.info: The Lucky Coin is a Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it causes enemies to drop extra coins when damaged and grants the player +0.05 luck.

Lucky Horseshoe.info: The Lucky Horseshoe is an accessory that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being found inside Skyware Chests on Floating Islands, as well as a 1/4 (25%) chance of being obtained from Sky Crates and Azure Crates. While equipped, it negates fall damage and grants +0.05 luck. This bonus does not stack with any of its upgrades.

Luminite.info: Luminite is a Hardmode ore dropped by the Moon Lord in stacks of 70–90 (90–110). It does not naturally generate in the world, and can be mined using any pickaxe.

Luminite Bar.info: The Luminite Bar is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord bar.

Luna's Runic Pixie Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Lunar Flare.info: The Lunar Flare is a Hardmode spell book that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it summons a spread of three lunar flares that rain down towards the cursor. The flares explode upon impact with enemies and blocks, but can pass through blocks until they have reached the cursor's location, then exploding.

Lunar Portal Staff.info: The Lunar Portal Staff is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord summon weapon that summons a Lunar Portal sentry. It continuously fires beams that sweep across enemies, which pierce infinite enemies but cannot pass through blocks. Unlike most sentries, the Lunar Portal floats midair. The Lunar Portal Staff has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord.

Mace.info: The Mace is a pre-Hardmode flail found in Gold Chests located in the underground or cavern layer.

Magic Cuffs.info: The Magic Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory.

Magic Dagger.info: The Magic Dagger is a Hardmode magic weapon that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by Mimics. When used, it rapidly fires Magic Dagger projectiles that travel in a straight line in the direction of the cursor for 24 tiles, then suddenly become affected by gravity. The projectiles can hit up to 3 enemies and cannot pass through blocks.

Magic Missile.info: The Magic Missile is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron wand. When used, it fires a magic missile that follows the cursor when ⚒ Use / Attack key is held. If the ⚒ Use / Attack key is released mid-drag, the missile will be fired in that direction. If the cursor is stationary on release, it is fired directly away from the player. Once it is released, the missile homes in on nearby enemies, creating a small explosion upon contact with an enemy or block.

Magic Quiver.info: The Magic Quiver is a Hardmode accessory that boosts arrow- and Stake-firing weapons. It has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance of being dropped from Skeleton Archers.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Magic String.info: The Magic String is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss accessory that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 1 Platinum. While equipped, all yoyos and counterweights are thrown when ⚒ Use / Attack is released, instead of being retracted. The released projectiles deal 75% of their initial damage and knockback, and can bounce and roll on blocks and platforms.

Magic Yoyo Bag.info: The Magic Yoyo Bag is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of Magic String and the Yoyo Bag.

Magical Harp.info: The Magical Harp is a Hardmode magic weapon that autofires ricocheting, piercing projectiles that graphically resemble purple musical notes. Each projectile lasts for 3 seconds before dissipating and will both ricochet infinitely and pierce enemies up to 5 times. The Magical Harp's musical notes gain a 5% damage penalty for each enemy hit. Notes produce a reasonable amount of purple light and are not affected by gravity.

Magiluminescence.info: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded.

Magma Skull.info: The Magma Skull is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Burning debuff. It also grants immunity to lava for 7 seconds.

Magma Stone.info: The Magma Stone is an accessory that causes the wearer's melee attacks to inflict the Hellfire debuff for up to 6 seconds on enemies. In PvP, only direct hits from melee weapons can inflict the Hellfire debuff, while melee projectiles instead inflict the On Fire! debuff; both debuffs last up to 6 seconds against other players. The Magma Stone also adds orange flame particle effects on the sprites of both the weapon and its projectiles, giving off light.

Magnet Flower.info: The Magnet Flower is a pre-Hardmode accessory.

Magnet Sphere.info: The Magnet Sphere is a Hardmode, post-Plantera spell book that has a 1/300 (0.33%) / 599/90,000 (0.6656%) chance of being dropped by Blue Armored Bones, Rusty Armored Bones, and Hell Armored Bones in the post-Plantera Dungeon. When used, it fires a slow-moving cyan sphere that rapidly fires instantaneous, non-piercing beams at the closest enemy as it travels. It passes through all enemies and bounces off solid blocks.

Malaise.info: The Malaise is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Mana Cloak.info: The Mana Cloak is a Hardmode accessory.

Mana Flower.info: The Mana Flower is a pre-Hardmode accessory that reduces mana cost by 8%, and automatically consumes mana potions in the player's inventory or opened Void Bag when mana is depleted.

Mana Potion.info: The Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 100 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It can be crafted or occasionally obtained from any Crates except for Wooden and Pearlwood Crates. They are also sold by the Merchant in Hardmode for 2 Silver 50 Copper.

Mana Regeneration Band.info: The Mana Regeneration Band is an accessory item made by combining a Band of Starpower and a Band of Regeneration at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Mandible Blade.info: The Mandible Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by Antlion Chargers and Antlion Swarmers. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapon in direction of the cursor, which can travel forward for 0.25 seconds before sharply dropping down. The Mandible Blade has a base 11% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Marrow.info: The Marrow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance to be dropped by Skeleton Archers. When used, it converts any type of arrow into high-velocity Bone Arrows that shatter into 2 bone shards upon hitting enemies or blocks, each of which deals 25% of the weapon's damage (11 base damage when using Wooden Arrows) but does not inflict knockback. The bone shards do not pierce and are launched away from the struck enemy or block, in addition to being heavily affected by gravity.

Master Ninja Gear.info: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear. It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, or the Dash button once, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

Mechanical Glove.info: The Mechanical Glove is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses accessory.

Mechanical Lens.info: The Mechanical Lens is an informational accessory which reveals placed Wire and Actuators. Each color of Wire can be shown at maximum brightness, regular, or faded, which is configurable via toggles. The Mechanical Lens is purchased from the Mechanic for 1 Gold.

Mechanical Ruler.info: The Mechanical Ruler is an informational accessory that, when equipped, draws a cyan, semi-transparent grid overlay on the screen, making individual block distances much clearer. This grid fades out when the player begins moving and returns once movement stops. The row and column of the block the mouse is hovering over are also highlighted in red, drawing a cross on the screen with the cursor at its center. The Mechanical Ruler can be purchased from the Mechanic for 1 Gold.

Medicated Bandage.info: The Medicated Bandage is an immunity accessory that combines the functions of the Adhesive Bandage and the Bezoar. This item grants immunity to any Bleeding and Poison debuffs.

Medusa Head.info: The Medusa Head is a Hardmode magic weapon that continuously fires close-range yellow beams up to four times per second, hitting up to three enemies per attack within a 20-tile radius of the player. 15 mana is consumed per each attack, regardless of the number of enemies struck. No mana is consumed if the Medusa Head is used while no enemies are within range. The Medusa Head has a 1/25 (4%) chance of being dropped by Medusa.

Megaphone.info: The Megaphone is an immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Silenced debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Pixies, Green Jellyfish, Dark Mummies, and Blood Mummies. While these are all Hardmode-exclusive enemies, the Megaphone can already be obtained in pre-Hardmode via Shimmer.

Megashark.info: The Megashark is a Hardmode, post-The Destroyer gun and the direct upgrade to the Minishark. When used, it fires bullets very rapidly in a small spread. It also has a 50% chance not to consume ammunition.

Meowmere.info: The Meowmere is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When swung, it fires a cat head projectile with a visual rainbow trail every 0.23 seconds. The cat head deals 125% of the weapon's damage (250 base damage), is affected by gravity, and can pierce enemies or bounce off blocks up to four times. Upon bouncing off a block, the cat head makes a "meow" sound and emits damaging rainbow explosions that grow in size with each bounce.

Metal Detector.info: The Metal Detector is an informational accessory that detects valuable objects, including ores, chests, Life Crystals, and Life Fruit, within a rectangular area of 170×125 tiles centered on the player. The Metal Detector displays the specific type of what was detected, for instance, "Chlorophyte detected nearby!" When multiple valuables are detected, only the one with the highest value is noted.

Meteor Staff.info: The Meteor Staff is a Hardmode wand. When used, it rapidly summons meteors from the sky which fall in the direction of the cursor and explode upon impact with an enemy or block.

Meteorite.info: Meteorite is a pre-Hardmode ore typically mined from Meteorite crash sites. It also spawns in high numbers during a Meteor Shower and rarely drops from Meteor Heads. A Meteorite crash site is a mini-biome guaranteed to spawn after the Eater of Worlds or Brain of Cthulhu is defeated for the first time. If the boss is defeated between midnight and dawn (12:00 AM – 4:30 AM), then the meteor crashes immediately. Otherwise, it will crash at the next midnight (12:00 AM).

Meteorite Bar.info: The Meteorite Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar. In addition to being crafted, Meteorite Bars can also be found as common items in Shadow Chests, or more rarely in Gold Chests in the Cavern layer that generate close to the Underworld.

Minishark.info: The Minishark is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 35 Gold. When used, it rapidly fires bullets at a slight spread, with each shot having a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of not consuming any ammunition.

Mobius Strip.info: The Mobius Strip is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance to drop from Golem.

Molotov Cocktail.info: The Molotov Cocktail is a consumable ranged weapon with a relatively short throwing arc. Upon hitting a solid object or enemy, it will explode and release 6 Molotov Fire light emitting projectiles, which can hit up to 3 targets. These smaller projectiles deal 50% damage (11 base damage), apply no knockback and inflict the On Fire! debuff on enemies for 3–6 seconds. Its high damage and ability to inflict fire damage make it a powerful early- to mid-pre-Hardmode weapon.

Molten Charm.info: The Molten Charm is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that combines the effects of the Lava Charm and Obsidian Skull.

Molten Fury.info: The Molten Fury is a pre-Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows, causing them to inflict the On Fire! debuff on hit.

Molten Quiver.info: The Molten Quiver is a Hardmode accessory that converts Wooden Arrows fired by the player into Flaming Arrows. In addition, it has the same effects as the Magic Quiver.

Molten Skull Rose.info: The Molten Skull Rose is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory. It grants 7 seconds of immunity to lava, immunity to the Burning debuff, and reduces damage taken from lava.

Monk's Belt.info: The Monk's Belt is a Hardmode accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%.  The Monk's Belt is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event with a 1/6 (16.67%) / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 2, and a 1/12 (8.33%) chance during Tier 3.

Moon Charm.info: The Moon Charm is a Hardmode accessory that, when equipped during nighttime, transforms the player into a werewolf and applies the Werewolf buff, which provides several stat bonuses. Additionally, the Moon Charm replaces the sound the player makes when damaged with the hurt sound that regular Werewolf enemies also have. The Werewolf buff does not pacify Werewolf enemies or make the player immune to damage from them. Although the regular Werewolf enemy is colored blue, the player Werewolf will be colored brown.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Moon Shell.info: The Moon Shell is a Hardmode accessory that can be crafted at the Tinkerer's Workshop.

Moon Stone.info: The Moon Stone is a Hardmode accessory which has a 1/35 (2.86%) / 69/1225 (5.63%) chance to drop from Vampires during the Solar Eclipse event. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

drops.rate: 1/10 (10%) (In what a horrible night to have a curse worlds (underground / cavern))

Moonglow.info: Moonglow is a type of herb which appears as a bent stalk with a drooping blue-white flower. It grows naturally on regular Jungle grass. Moonglow can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool, and can be planted manually using Moonglow Seeds in Clay Pots and Planter Boxes, or on suitable soil tiles.

Morning Star.info: The Morning Star is a Hardmode, post-Plantera whip that has a 1/200 (0.5%) / 399/40,000 (0.9975%) chance of being dropped by Blue Armored Bones, Rusty Armored Bones, and Hell Armored Bones in the Hardmode Dungeon.

Mothron Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Mud Ball.info: The Mud Ball is a consumable weapon. When used, it throws a Mud Ball projectile that is affected by gravity, pierces enemies infinitely, and places a Mud Block upon hitting the ground. If the hit location is occupied by other foreground objects, the Mud Block will be broken into item form.

Mud Block.info: Mud Blocks are a very common block type that comprises the majority of the Jungle, Underground Jungle, and Glowing Mushroom biome. It also generates in irregular patches in the Cavern layer. Mud Blocks may be covered by Jungle grass, Mushroom grass, Corrupt grass, or Crimson grass on any side, which can be planted with Jungle Grass Seeds, Mushroom Grass Seeds, Corrupt Seeds, and Crimson Seeds. Only Jungle grass and Mushroom grass are incapable of growing on Dirt Blocks.

Mug.info: The Mug is a cup made of Glass. It can be used to craft Ale. It can be placed on a flat furniture item, where it functions as a Placed Bottle crafting station.

Muramasa.info: The Muramasa is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron broadsword that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes. When swung, it creates a blue slash upon enemy hits. The slashes deal 50% of the weapon's damage (12 base damage), inflict no knockback, do not pierce, and have 5 armor penetration.

Mushroom.info: The Mushroom is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion that spawns randomly on grass or Hallowed grass on the surface layer. It can be harvested with any tool or weapon.

Mushroom Grass Seeds.info: Mushroom Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant Mushroom grass on Mud Blocks. They can be found by harvesting Glowing Mushrooms and by shaking and cutting down Giant Glowing Mushrooms. They can also be purchased from the Dryad for 1 Silver 50 Copper each if she is spoken to in a Glowing Mushroom biome, and they can be obtained from putting Poo into an Extractinator, with a 1/150 (0.67%) chance per item.

Mushroom Spear.info: The Mushroom Spear is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss spear that can be purchased from the Truffle for 70 Gold. When thrust, it summons seven spinning mushrooms that linger in midair and deal 33.33% of the weapon's damage (20 base damage) but do not inflict knockback.

Mushroom Staff.info: The Mushroom Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Mushroom Boi minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, dealing contact damage. If the nearest target is too far away, the Mushroom Boi will dive towards it, creating a red explosion on impact that deals 133% of the weapon's damage (10 base damage) and 300% of its knockback (base knockback of 6 (Average)), and then teleport back to the player.

Musket.info: The Musket is a pre-Hardmode gun. It will always drop from the first Shadow Orb destroyed in a Corruption world (along with 100 Musket Balls) and has a 1/5 (20%) chance of dropping from destroyed Shadow Orbs afterward. It also has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from Corrupt(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Defiled Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) fished in the Corruption. The Musket has a base 12% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Mystic Arts Sash.info: The Mystic Arts Sash is a Hardmode accessory item made by combining a Mana Regeneration Band and a Black Belt at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Mystic Bloom.info: The Mystic Bloom is a pre-Hardmode magic weapon that fires three non-piercing petals which slowly home in on nearby enemies within a 25-tile radius and can bounce off blocks, each dealing 100% of the weapon's damage and knockback. If no enemies are within range, the petals instead linger in place after traveling a short distance.

Mythril Anvil.info: The Mythril Anvil and Orichalcum Anvil are Hardmode crafting stations that serve and extend the function of a pre-Hardmode Anvil. These are very crucial to game advancement, as they account for making nearly every Hardmode recipe before the Ancient Manipulator.

Mythril Bar.info: The Mythril Bar is a Hardmode bar. It is one of the two ores able to create a Hardmode Anvil, which is used to craft most Hardmode equipment.

Mythril Halberd.info: The Mythril Halberd is a Hardmode spear.

Mythril Ore.info: Mythril Ore belongs to the second tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the second altar broken, either it or Orichalcum Ore can spawn in the cavern layer. Mining Mythril Ore requires a Cobalt/Palladium Pickaxe or better.

Mythril Repeater.info: The Mythril Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Mythril Sword.info: The Mythril Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Nail Gun.info: The Nail Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that consumes Nails as ammunition. When used, it fires a Nail that deals 15% of the weapon's damage (17 base damage) and sticks to enemies or blocks before exploding after 1.5 seconds, dealing 135% damage (155 base damage). Nails are unaffected by gravity until they have traveled roughly 30 tiles, after which they move with an arc similar to that of arrows.

Nature's Gift.info: Nature's Gift is an accessory that reduces the mana cost of using magic weapons and other mana-consuming items by 6%. It is acquired by harvesting a rare flower that grows on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle, using any weapon or tool. The flower appears as a blue version of the Jungle Rose.

Nazar.info: The Nazar is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Cursed debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Cursed Skulls, Giant Cursed Skulls, Cursed Hammers, Crimson Axes, and Enchanted Swords.

Nebula Arcanum.info: The Nebula Arcanum is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist magic weapon that fires a swirling purple orb when used. The orb will slowly home in on enemies within a 50-tile range and bounce off blocks, hitting three times before exploding into 10–16 smaller shard projectiles that each deal 65% of the weapon's listed damage (45 base damage), inflict 80% of its knockback (base knockback of 4 (Weak)), and do not pierce.

Nebula Blaze.info: The Nebula Blaze is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist magic weapon that inaccurately fires pink, high-velocity projectiles which home in on nearby enemies, with a 1/5 (20%) chance to fire a larger blue Nebula Blaze Ex projectile that deals 300% of the weapon's damage (390 base damage) and moves 60% faster.

Nebula Fragment.info: The Nebula Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100. Nebula Fragments can be used to craft Nebula armor, an end-game armor set that benefits all types of magic weapons, as well as Nebula-themed tools, weapons, wings, etc.

Nebula Mantle.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Necromantic Scroll.info: The Necromantic Scroll is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that increases the player's minion slots by one and increases the damage of all summon weapons by 10%. It is dropped by the Mourning Wood during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.86–20% (5–20%) chance depending on the current wave.

Neon Moss.info: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Neon Moss Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Neptune's Shell.info: Neptune's Shell is a Hardmode accessory that aids maneuverability in water, honey, and Shimmer by granting indefinite breathing time while submerged, swimming via the ↷ Jump key, and eliminating the slow movement speed usually caused by submerging underwater. Entering applicable liquids with this accessory equipped transforms the player into a merperson and grants the Merfolk buff. While in this form, the breath meter will refill as if the player is in open air, therefore effectively preventing drowning.

Nettle Burst.info: The Nettle Burst is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it extends a snaking vine from the player's position, which passes through blocks, pierces infinite enemies, and deals 0.17 s global invincibility.

Night's Edge.info: The Night's Edge is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron broadsword. When swung, a circular purple aura follows the swing, reaching slightly farther than the sword itself. Another aura swings towards the cursor, further increasing range. The auras can hit up to two enemies each, but the same enemy cannot be hit by both auras.

Nightglow.info: The Nightglow is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic weapon that fires four rainbow-colored projectiles which emerge from the player and home in on nearby enemies. Each projectile ricochets off solid blocks and can pierce twice before dissipating on the third hit, but loses 20% of its damage for each enemy struck. The Nightglow has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light.

Nimbus Rod.info: The Nimbus Rod is a Hardmode magic weapon that creates storm clouds that drop damaging "rain" projectiles directly below themselves. When cast, a cloud projectile is fired from the Nimbus Rod and travels towards the cursor. Upon reaching its destination or colliding with a solid block, the cloud stops and starts sending damaging raindrop particles downward, each dealing the weapon's stated damage. The raindrop can hit up to 5 targets. Each cloud lasts for five minutes and up to two clouds can be spawned at once.

North Pole.info: The North Pole is a Hardmode, post-Plantera spear that is dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave. When thrust, it fires an icy spear projectile that is unaffected by gravity until after traveling for 0.5 seconds. It can pierce enemies twice and cannot pass through blocks. The spear also releases a trail of damaging snowflakes that rain down, dissipating upon contact with an enemy or block.

Obsidian.info: Obsidian is a pre-Hardmode ore that is created when water and lava collide. Mining Obsidian requires a Gold/Platinum Pickaxe or better. Explosives can also destroy Obsidian.

Obsidian Horseshoe.info: The Obsidian Horseshoe is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory.

Obsidian Rose.info: The Obsidian Rose is an accessory that reduces the base damage taken from lava from 80 to 35 and halves the duration of the On Fire! debuff inflicted by it from 7 / 14 / 17.5 seconds to 3.5 / 7 / 8.75 seconds.

Obsidian Shield.info: The Obsidian Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants +2 defense, immunity to knockback, and immunity to the Burning debuff.

Obsidian Skull.info: The Obsidian Skull is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants +1 defense and immunity to the Burning debuff inflicted upon contact with Meteorite, Hellstone, Hellstone Bricks, or Ancient Hellstone Bricks. It does not grant immunity to lava or fire-based attacks.

Obsidian Skull Rose.info: The Obsidian Skull Rose is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants immunity to the Burning debuff and reduced damage from lava.

Obsidian Swordfish.info: The Obsidian Swordfish is a Hardmode spear that is obtained via fishing in lava, by using any lava fishing method (including lava bait or Lavaproof Fishing Hook). When thrust, it fires 1–3 piercing gravity-affected embers that each deal 50% of the weapon's damage (35 base damage) and inflict the Hellfire debuff for 3-6 seconds. The embers can hit a total of 3 enemies and do not inflict any knockback. The Obsidian Swordfish also has a 24% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Obsidian Water Walking Boots.info: Obsidian Water Walking Boots are a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grant the ability to walk on water, honey, and Shimmer(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), while also giving immunity to the Burning debuff. They do not allow walking on lava.

Onyx Blaster.info: The Onyx Blaster is a Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Shotgun. When used, it fires a spread of 4 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition. It also fires an onyx crystal that explodes upon impact with an enemy or a block, or after traveling for 0.33 seconds. The projectile deals 200% of the weapon's damage, e.g. 62 damage when using Musket Ball.

Optic Staff.info: The Optic Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a miniature version of The Twins as minions. The pair of minions, named Spazmamini and Retanimini, fly towards enemies to dash through them and fire lasers at them, respectively. Each pair of Twins counts as a single minion towards the minion slot cap.

Orange Bloodroot.info: The Orange Bloodroot is a type of plant. It can grow below Dirt Blocks in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Orange Dye.

Orange Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Orange Phaseblade.info: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them. They can be recalled by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again, which will damage enemies along the way. They can also be recalled mid-throw.

Orange Phasesaber.info: Phasesabers are a group of Hardmode broadswords, direct upgrades to the phaseblades with much more damage and slightly faster use time. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them.

Orange String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Orange Zapinator.info: The Orange Zapinator is a Hardmode magic gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 Gold.

Orichalcum Bar.info: The Orichalcum Bar is a Hardmode bar. It is one of the two ores able to create a Hardmode Anvil, which is used to craft most Hardmode equipment.

Orichalcum Halberd.info: The Orichalcum Halberd is a Hardmode spear.

Orichalcum Ore.info: Orichalcum Ore belongs to the second tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the second altar broken, either it or Mythril Ore can spawn in the cavern layer. Mining Orichalcum Ore requires a Cobalt/Palladium Pickaxe or better.

Orichalcum Repeater.info: The Orichalcum Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Orichalcum Sword.info: The Orichalcum Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Ouroboros Ring.info: The Ouroboros Ring is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory.

PDA.info: The PDA is a post-Skeletron informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, the weather, wind speed, moon phase, the player's Fishing Power, the most valuable block nearby, nearby rare creatures, the number of nearby enemies, the player's enemy kill count, the player's current DPS, the player's current movement speed, the player's horizontal position, and the player's depth.

Paint Sprayer.info: The Paint Sprayer is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 Gold. While equipped, or (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) when held in the inventory, it automatically applies paint or coating to any object when placing it. Like the Paintbrush and the Paint Roller, it will use the paint that is first in order in the inventory.

Paintball Gun.info: The Paintball Gun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that fires a three-shot burst of slow-moving, arcing multicolored Paintball projectiles which consume no mana or ammunition, dissipating upon contact with an enemy or surface. The Paintball Gun has a 11% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%. It has a 1/10 (10%) chance of being dropped by the Painter.

Paladin's Hammer.info: The Paladin's Hammer is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that has a 1/15 (6.67%) / 29/225 (12.89%) chance of being dropped by Paladins in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it swings once before being thrown at a high velocity, piercing an infinite number of enemies, and returning to the player after traveling a certain distance or upon hitting solid blocks.

Paladin's Shield.info: The Paladin's Shield is a Hardmode, post-Plantera shield that has a 1/10 (10%) / 19/100 (19%) chance of being dropped by Paladins in the Hardmode Dungeon.

Palladium Bar.info: The Palladium Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Palladium Ore.info: Palladium Ore belongs to the first tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the first altar broken, either it or Cobalt Ore will spawn in the underground and cavern layers. Mining Palladium Ore requires a Molten Pickaxe or better.

Palladium Pike.info: The Palladium Pike is a Hardmode spear.

Palladium Repeater.info: The Palladium Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Palladium Sword.info: The Palladium Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Palm Wood.info: Palm Wood is a type of wood harvested from Palm trees found naturally growing in the Ocean biome and Oasis biome. Palm trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of regular Sand Blocks above surface.

Palm Wood Bow.info: The Palm Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Palm Wood Sword.info: The Palm Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Panic Necklace.info: The Panic Necklace is an accessory, that, when equipped, grants the player the Panic! buff for 8 seconds when harmed by any source of damage besides fire blocks, increasing movement speed by 100%. The Panic Necklace has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Crimson Hearts found in The Crimson or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Crimson Crates and Hematic Crates, which are fished in the Crimson. It can furthermore be crafted.

Paper Airplane.info: The Paper Airplane and White Paper Airplane are consumable ranged weapons. When thrown, they will travel in a different path each time, as they are affected by wind speed and direction, which is especially apparent on a Windy Day. The two variants are functionally identical. They are sometimes dropped by slimes that are carried by Windy Balloons, which can spawn during a Windy Day.

Papyrus Scarab.info: The Papyrus Scarab is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that combines the bonuses of the Necromantic Scroll and the Hercules Beetle.

Pearlsand Block.info: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions. Sand can spread and be converted by the evil biomes and The Hallow (see below).

Pearlsandstone Block.info: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome.

Pearlstone Block.info: The Pearlstone Block is a Hardmode block type found in The Hallow. It requires at least a Nightmare Pickaxe, Deathbringer Pickaxe, or explosives to mine.

Pearlwood.info: Pearlwood is a Hardmode-exclusive type of wood harvested from Pearlwood trees and Pearlwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Hallow biomes. Pearlwood trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Hallowed grass or Mowed Hallowed grass above surface, and Pearlwood Palm trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Pearlsand Blocks above surface.

Pearlwood Bow.info: The Pearlwood Bow is a Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Pearlwood Sword.info: The Pearlwood Sword is a Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Pew-matic Horn.info: The Pew-matic Horn is a pre-Hardmode gun that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Deerclops. When used, it converts any bullet into a randomized item fired as a projectile. The projectiles travel in an arc and dissipate upon contact with an enemy or block. The projectile's damage varies depending on its appearance.

Phantasm.info: The Phantasm is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist bow. When used, it fires a burst of four arrows that are loosely grouped together, while only consuming one arrow per use. Its fire rate will gradually increase while in use. Upon enemy hits, the Phantasm fires an additional burst of three Phantasm Arrow projectiles. Phantasm Arrows home in on the hit target, move through blocks, deal 30% of the original projectile's damage, and inflict no knockback. The Phantasm has a 2/3 (66.67%) chance of not consuming ammunition.

Phantom Phoenix.info: The Phantom Phoenix is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss bow. When used, it fires a slight spread of two arrows, alongside a large Phoenix projectile on every third use. The weapon only consumes 1 arrow per use, and its use time is increased by 50% after firing a Phoenix projectile (base use time of 27 (Average)) but returns to normal after firing arrows.

Pharaoh's Mask.info: The Pharaoh's set is a vanity set consisting of the Pharaoh's Mask and the Pharaoh's Robe. A full set can be found in a Gold Chest within a Pyramid, at a 1/9 (11.11%) chance. On Celebration Mk 10 worlds, this chance is guaranteed.

Pharaoh's Robe.info: The Pharaoh's set is a vanity set consisting of the Pharaoh's Mask and the Pharaoh's Robe. A full set can be found in a Gold Chest within a Pyramid, at a 1/9 (11.11%) chance. On Celebration Mk 10 worlds, this chance is guaranteed.

Philosopher's Stone.info: The Philosopher's Stone is a Hardmode accessory which decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Philosopher's Stone reduces it to 45 seconds. It has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance to be dropped by Mimics.

Phoenix Blaster.info: The Phoenix Blaster is a pre-Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Handgun, with increased damage and velocity but slightly less knockback.

Phoenix Quiver.info: The Phoenix Quiver is a Hardmode accessory made by combining a Harpy Charm and a Molten Quiver at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Pink Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Pink Gel.info: Pink Gel is a rare crafting material dropped by Pinky in stacks of 25–50. It is primarily used to craft "bouncy" versions of certain consumable items, as well as Restoration Potions. "Bouncy" items act like their normal variants, but bounce more times and more vigorously before losing momentum.

Pink Horseshoe Balloon.info: The Pink Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33% and jump speed by 30%, grants a double jump, and grants +0.05 luck. The height of the first jump is increased from 6 blocks to 10.5 blocks (~75% increase), while the double jump's height is increased from 7 blocks to 13 blocks, reaching a total of 23.5 blocks with both jumps.

Pink Ice Block.info: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes. They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill. Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them.

Pink Pearl.info: Pearls are crafting materials obtained from opening Oysters, and are used to craft Luck Potions. Each of the three pearls have different rarities, with the rarer ones being crafted into stronger potions. Additionally, when the Pink Pearl is thrown into Shimmer, it turns into a Galaxy Pearl. The player can only receive one pearl from each Oyster, with a 1/4 (25%) chance in total.

Pink Prickly Pear.info: The Pink Prickly Pear is a dye material. It grows on top of regular or Hallowed Cacti above surface, but can also be seen on top of Corrupt or Crimson Cacti (see Notes for details). Unlike many plants, instead of being broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to craft Pink Dye.

White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Piranha Gun.info: The Piranha Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged weapon that costs no ammunition. It fires a spread of three returning Mechanical Piranha projectiles that inflict the Hemorrhage debuff for 4–6 seconds on hit. The Mechanical Piranha initially moves in a straight path until it collides with an enemy, at which point it latches into the target, follows its movement and deals continuous damage while the ⚒ Use / Attack button is held.

Pirate Staff.info: The Pirate Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Pirate minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, attacking with a sword up close. When trying to reach an enemy that is too high above it, the Pirate minion can also double jump or use a grappling hook while mid-air to reach it.

Pixie Dust.info: Pixie Dust is a common Hardmode crafting material that always drops from Pixies.

Platinum Bar.info: The Platinum Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Platinum Bow.info: The Platinum Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Platinum Broadsword.info: The Platinum Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Platinum Shortsword.

Platinum Ore.info: Platinum Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Platinum Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Platinum Shortsword.info: The Platinum Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Platinum Broadsword.

Platinum Watch.info: Watches are informational accessories that show the current in-game time in the top-right corner of the screen.

Pocket Mirror.info: The Pocket Mirror is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Stoned debuff. It has a 1/40 (2.5%) / 1/20 (5%) chance of being dropped by naturally spawned Medusas.

Poison Barb.info: The Poison Barb is a pre-Hardmode combat accessory that causes arrows fired by the player to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 1.5 seconds. The Poison Barb has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being found inside surface Chests, or a 1/120 (0.83%) chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing.

Poison Staff.info: The Poison Staff is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance of being dropped by Black Recluses. When used, it fires a burst of 3–4 Poison Fangs in a roughly 30° spread. Each projectile pierces two enemies and inflicts the Poisoned debuff for 30 seconds.

Poisoned Knife.info: The Poisoned Knife is a consumable ranged weapon that has a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff. It otherwise behaves exactly like the Throwing Knife, except for having slightly better stats overall and auto-use. It can hit up to 2 targets.

Portable Cement Mixer.info: The Portable Cement Mixer is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 Gold. While equipped, it grants +50% placement speed when placing walls.

Possessed Hatchet.info: The Possessed Hatchet is a Hardmode, post-Golem boomerang that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped from Golem. When thrown, it homes in on enemies within 50 tiles and inflicts the Hemorrhage debuff on hit. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with no limit to the number that can be thrown out at one time.

Possession.info: Possession is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord whip that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord.

Power Bomb.info: The Power Bomb is a Hardmode explosive that is a direct upgrade to the Bomb. It explodes 5 seconds after being thrown, and breaks nearly all blocks, background walls, and furniture within a radius of 9 tiles. Unlike other explosives, it can additionally destroy the early Hardmode ores, although it still cannot destroy other explosion-proof objects. The explosion also deals 200 classless damage to all enemies, critters, and players (but not NPCs) within 8.75 tiles horizontally and vertically of the Power Bomb.

Power Glove.info: The Power Glove is a Hardmode accessory.

Presserator.info: The Presserator is a construction accessory that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 Gold. It automatically places Actuators to objects when placing them. It requires Actuators to be in the player's inventory in order to function.

Pretty Mirror.info: The Pretty Mirror is a consumable weapon that can be thrown at targets. The damage it deals is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment. The Pretty Mirror can be purchased from the Stylist while in a Graveyard for 1 Gold. Upon breaking, the Pretty Mirror decreases luck by 0.25 for 7 minutes to all players within a 19.875×19.875-tile rectangular area centered on the point of impact.

Proximity Mine Launcher.info: The Proximity Mine Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that can be purchased from the Cyborg for 35 Gold. When used, it consumes a rocket and fires a mine that travels in a short arc before becoming stationary and semi-transparent until an enemy approaches or until a minute passes, at which point it explodes. The player will not activate the mine, but will be damaged by an exploding mine.

Psycho Knife.info: The Psycho Knife is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that has a 1/40 (2.5%) / 79/1600 (4.94%) chance of being dropped by Psychos during the Solar Eclipse event. When holding the Psycho Knife and standing still, the player will quickly enter stealth, causing them to turn almost invisible, move much more slowly, and no longer be targeted by certain enemies' projectile attacks.

Pulse Bow.info: The Pulse Bow is a Hardmode bow that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 45 Gold after defeating all three mechanical bosses. When used, it converts any type of arrow into a high-velocity Pulse Bolt. The Pulse Bolt is unaffected by gravity, can either pierce enemies or bounce off blocks up to five times, and travels for 3.33 seconds before dissipating. The Pulse Bow also has a base 11% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Pumpkin.info: Pumpkin is a crafting material obtained by harvesting Pumpkin plants using any weapon or tool.

Purple Clubberfish.info: The Purple Clubberfish is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that can be obtained by fishing in The Corruption with a 1/10 (10%) chance with 100 Fishing Power, up to a maximum 1/4 (25%) chance with 300 Fishing Power. It has a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the Confused debuff for 1–3 seconds on hit.

Purple Counterweight.info: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player. Counterweights deal the yoyo's full damage and stay active until the yoyo is retracted towards the player. There are six different color variants with identical functionalities.
