Putrid Scent.info: The Putrid Scent is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) chance to be dropped by Corrupt Mimics. While equipped, it increases the player's damage and critical strike chance by 5% and decreases aggro by 400.

Pygmy Necklace.info: The Pygmy Necklace is a pre-Hardmode accessory that provides the player with one additional minion slot. It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for 20 Gold at night.

Pygmy Staff.info: The Pygmy Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Pygmy minion. It fires a spear towards nearby enemies that inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 5–10 seconds, but does not pierce enemies or pass through blocks. The Pygmy Staff has a 1/4 (25%) / 1/2 (50%) chance of being dropped by Plantera.

Pyroclastic Stone.info: The Pyroclastic Stone is a pre-Hardmode accessory that combines and improves the effects of the Magma Stone and Snapping Stone.

Quad-Barrel Shotgun.info: The Quad-Barrel Shotgun is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron gun that can be purchased for 35 Gold from the Arms Dealer when he is spoken to in a Graveyard. When used, it fires eight bullets at a 45° spread, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Queen Spider Staff.info: The Queen Spider Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Spider Turret sentry. It fires Spider Eggs towards enemies once per second, which can bounce and roll on blocks, and are heavily affected by gravity. The Spider Eggs deal no damage themselves, and upon colliding with enemies or after 1 second, they will break and spawn 2–4 Baby Spiders that attack enemies. The Baby Spiders will disappear upon contact with an enemy, dealing damage and inflicting the Acid Venom debuff for 2–4 seconds.

R.E.K. 3000.info: The R.E.K. 3000  is a post-Skeletron informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of nearby rare creatures, the number of nearby enemies, and the player's enemy kill count.

Radar.info: The Radar is an informational accessory that displays the number of nearby enemies in a 125-tile radius around the player.

Rainbow Crystal Staff.info: The Rainbow Crystal Staff is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord summon weapon that summons a Rainbow Crystal sentry. It fires spreads of three multicolored light beams towards enemies, but cannot target through blocks. Each beam releases a star that explodes shortly after. Unlike most sentries, the Rainbow Crystal floats midair. The Rainbow Crystal Staff has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord.

The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Rainbow Gun.info: The Rainbow Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic gun that fires a curving rainbow which persists for 40 seconds or until another rainbow is fired, and repeatedly deals damage to enemies that touch it. The rainbow can be also forced to dissipate instantly by using ⚷ Open / Activate on it while the player is within 15 tiles of it. The Rainbow Gun is always found in the Dungeon's Hallowed Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Hallowed Key after Plantera has been defeated.

Rainbow Rod.info: The Rainbow Rod is a Hardmode, post-The Twins wand. When used, it fires a rainbow missile that follows the cursor when ⚒ Use / Attack key is held. If the ⚒ Use / Attack key is released mid-drag, the missile will be fired in that direction. If the cursor is stationary on release, it is fired directly away from the player. Once it is released, the missile homes in on nearby enemies and can pierce twice, creating a small explosion upon contact with a block or third enemy.

White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Rally.info: The Rally is a pre-Hardmode yoyo that has a 6.5% chance of being dropped by Crawdads, Giant Shellies, and Salamanders in the Cavern layer.

Ram Rune.info: The Ram Rune is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron accessory that can be obtained as secondary loot from Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and from Golden Lock Boxes found in Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates. When equipped, it allows the player to do a "ground pound" by holding ▼ Down and pressing ↷ Jump while in midair.

Ranger Emblem.info: The Ranger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases ranged damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Raven Staff.info: The Raven Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Raven minion. It flies and charges through enemies. The Raven Staff is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave.

Razorblade Typhoon.info: The Razorblade Typhoon is a Hardmode spell book that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it fires a high-velocity homing typhoon. The typhoon can pierce enemies and bounce off blocks infinitely, and it lasts for 1.67 seconds.

Razorpine.info: The Razorpine is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% (6.22%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave. When used, it rapidly fires 2–4 high-velocity pine needles in a spread, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks. The needles become affected by gravity after traveling a medium distance.

Recon Scope.info: The Recon Scope is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory.

They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player. The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Red Husk.info: The Red Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Cochineal Beetles. Its sole purpose is to make Red Dye.

Red Ice Block.info: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes. They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill. Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them.

Red Phaseblade.info: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them. They can be recalled by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again, which will damage enemies along the way. They can also be recalled mid-throw.

Red Phasesaber.info: Phasesabers are a group of Hardmode broadswords, direct upgrades to the phaseblades with much more damage and slightly faster use time. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them.

Red Rocket.info: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 Silver each.

Red Ryder.info: The Red Ryder is a pre-Hardmode gun dropped from Presents obtained during Christmas, with a 0.643% chance in pre-Hardmode and 0.6% chance in Hardmode.

Red String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Red's Throw.info: Red's Throw is a Hardmode, Expert Mode-exclusive yoyo that can be obtained from any Hardmode boss's Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime's) as part of Red's set.

Red's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Reflective Shades.info: The Reflective Shades are a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Darkness and Stoned debuffs.

Resonance Scepter.info: The Resonance Scepter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by the Princess. When used, it creates pink circular auras at the cursor's location, which expand and then collapse into sparkles over the course of 1 second. The auras deal rapid damage and knockback.

Restoration Shield.info: The Restoration Shield is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron shield accessory item made by combining a Cobalt Shield and a Mana Regeneration Band at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Revolver.info: The Revolver is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 15 Gold after a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart has been smashed. Firing the Revolver just as it comes off cooldown will gradually increase its attack speed (up to 100%) and critical strike chance (up to 20%). This effect will not be triggered if the player is autofiring the weapon.

Rich Mahogany.info: Rich Mahogany is a type of wood harvested from Mahogany trees found naturally growing in the Jungle and Underground Jungle, or from Living Mahogany Trees, Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle, and Jungle Shrines. Mahogany trees can naturally grow from Jungle grass above surface, or they can also be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Jungle grass above surface.

Rich Mahogany Bow.info: The Rich Mahogany Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Rich Mahogany Sword.info: The Rich Mahogany Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Rifle Scope.info: The Rifle Scope is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory. It grants the ability to increase view range while holding a gun by pressing and holding ⚷ Open / Activate and moving the cursor.

Rocket Boots.info: Rocket Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 5 Gold. While equipped, they allow the player to hold ↷ Jump in midair to fly for a total of 1.17 seconds. While flying, the boots emit visual flame particles that give off a large amount of light.

Rocket Launcher.info: The Rocket Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that has a 1/18 (5.56%) / 35/324 (10.8%) chance of being dropped by Skeleton Commandos in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires rockets as ammunition, which can damage the player for a flat 60 damage. Enemies that are directly hit by rockets take double damage (110 base damage). This also doubles the damage from ammunition.

Rotten Egg.info: The Rotten Egg is a consumable ranged weapon obtained commonly from Goodie Bags, which are dropped during the Halloween season, and from shaking trees during that time. They explode on impact.

Royal Gel.info: The Royal Gel is a pre-Hardmode accessory that pacifies most slimes when equipped, causing them to no longer pursue the player, and will deal no contact damage or fire projectiles, even if the player deals damage to them. The Royal Gel is always dropped from King Slime's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Royal Guard's Harness.info: The Royal Guard's Harness is a Hardmode shield accessory.

Ruby.info: Ruby is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Ruby Bunny.info: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.

Ruby Squirrel.info: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Ruby Staff.info: The Ruby Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that quickly fires a red bolt, which deals 50% of the weapon's damage (9 base damage) and 100% of its knockback, and has 4 armor penetration, but does not pierce. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).

Ruinous Staff.info: The Ruinous Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon crafted using desert and light/dark materials. It summons a Forbidden Ruin minion that hovers above the player. Upon finding a target, the Forbidden Ruin aggressively chases it and tries to stay at a short fixed distance to its target, while firing high-velocity Forbidden Bolt projectiles towards it which gradually slow down.

Ruler.info: The Ruler is a pre-Hardmode shortsword purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 Silver. It swings four times in quick succession per use, with slightly varying angles with each stab.

S.D.M.G..info: The S.D.M.G. (Space Dolphin Machine Gun) is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a small spread. It also has a 66% chance not to consume ammunition. The S.D.M.G. has a base 14% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%.

Safeman's Blanket Cape.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Sailfish Boots.info: The Sailfish Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Wooden Crates and Iron Crates. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of water particles as they sprint.

Sand Block.info: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions. Sand can spread and be converted by the evil biomes and The Hallow (see below).

Sandgun.info: The Sandgun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that fires sand ball projectiles that are affected by gravity. Upon contact with an enemy or block, the sand ball turns into its respective form of block (if the space is not occupied).

Sandstone Block.info: Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome.

Sandstorm in a Balloon.info: The Sandstorm in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the functions of the Sandstorm in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon. It boosts jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the player's first jump's height to 10.5 tiles, and provides a double jump that can reach a height of 26.5 tiles, for a total height of 37 tiles.

Sandstorm in a Bottle.info: The Sandstorm in a Bottle is an accessory found inside Gold Chests within Pyramids. On the  Desktop version,  Console version, and  Mobile version, it can also be obtained by throwing a Pharaoh's Mask into Shimmer, opening Oasis/Mirage Crates, and via crafting in Hardmode.

Sanguine Staff.info: The Sanguine Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Sanguine Bat minion. It flies in an elliptical loop between the player and the target enemy. Sanguine Bats arrange themselves along a semicircle around the player's head, and immediately return to the player if no enemies are nearby. The Sanguine Staff has a 1/2 (50%) / guaranteed chance of being dropped by Dreadnautiluses.

Sapphire.info: Sapphire is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. It can craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and has no exclusive recipes.

Sapphire Bunny.info: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.

Sapphire Squirrel.info: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Sapphire Staff.info: The Sapphire Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires 2 blue bolts which move in a helix pattern and do not pierce, and each deal 60% of the weapon's damage (10 base damage) and 100% of its knockback. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolts will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting them additional effects (see Notes for details).

Sawmill.info: The Sawmill is a crafting station for advanced Wood and Furniture crafting. It is 3 blocks wide, 3 blocks high, and must be placed on top of solid blocks or platforms.

Scarab Bomb.info: The Scarab Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Sticky Bomb, but instead creates a 21-tile long and 3-tile wide shaft. The explosion will always aim away from the player's position, even after being thrown.

Scourge of the Corruptor.info: The Scourge of the Corruptor is a Hardmode, post-Plantera melee weapon. When used, it fires an Eater's Bite, a fast javelin-like projectile, that splits into weaker Tiny Eater projectiles upon contact with enemies or blocks. Tiny Eaters home in on enemies and bounce up to five times before dissipating.

Scout's Sling.info: The Scout's Sling is a Hardmode accessory.

Seedler.info: The Seedler is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Plantera. When swung, it fires Seedler Nut projectiles that travel in a downwards arc before exploding into 4–7 Seedler Thorns upon hitting an enemy or after 0.33–2.15 seconds. Seedler Thorns deal 70% of the weapon's damage (35 base damage) and knockback (base knockback of 4.2 (Average)), are unaffected by gravity, and target nearby enemies when fired.

Seraph Necklace.info: The Seraph Necklace is a Hardmode accessory made by combining a Harpy Charm and a Cross Necklace at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the effects of the two accessories, periodically redirecting arrows towards enemies and doubling the length of invincibility after taking damage. In addition, the cooldown of the Seraph Necklace's arrow-redirecting effect is 20% lower than the Harpy Charm's, at 1.2 seconds.

Sergeant United Shield.info: The Sergeant United Shield is a Hardmode boomerang that is rarely sold by the Traveling Merchant for 35 Gold. When thrown, it homes in on enemies within 50 tiles and will attempt to hit up to five enemies before returning to the player, but loses 20% of its damage for each enemy struck.

Sextant.info: The Sextant is an informational accessory that displays the current moon phase.

Shackle.info: The Shackle is an accessory that grants 1 point of defense. It is dropped by most kinds of Zombies with a 1/50 (2%) chance. Shackles may be useful early in the game when only few accessories are available. Typically, they should be replaced with more valuable accessories once out of free slots.

Shadewood.info: Shadewood is a type of wood harvested from Shadewood trees and Shadewood Palm trees found naturally growing in Crimson biomes. Shadewood trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Crimson grass or Crimson Jungle grass above surface, and Shadewood Palm trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Crimsand Blocks above surface.

Shadewood Bow.info: The Shadewood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Shadewood Sword.info: The Shadewood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Shadow Jousting Lance.info: The Shadow Jousting Lance is a Hardmode, post-Plantera melee weapon. When attacking using ⚒ Use / Attack, the lance will extend, and holding ⚒ Use / Attack will keep it extended at a fixed angle. The damage and knockback will increase depending on the player's movement speed, making mounts, sprinting accessories, or dash abilities (such as those granted by Shield of Cthulhu, Tabi/Master Ninja Gear, or Solar Flare armor) useful for maximizing damage.

Shadow Scale.info: The Shadow Scale is a pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped from the Eater of Worlds (and its Treasure Bag in Expert Mode).

Shadowbeam Staff.info: The Shadowbeam Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 (5%) / 39/400 (9.75%) chance of being dropped by Necromancers in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires a purple beam that travels almost instantly to its maximum distance (112.5 tiles), bouncing off blocks on impact. The beam can pierce infinite enemies, but for each enemy hit, its damage is reduced by 10%. Each enemy can only be hit once.

Shadowflame Bow.info: The Shadowflame Bow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/6 (16.67%) / 1/3 (33.33%) chance to drop from Goblin Warlocks during a Hardmode Goblin Army. When used, it converts any type of arrow into Shadowflame Arrows. Shadowflame Arrows can pierce two enemies and inflict the Shadowflame debuff for 2–5 seconds. Shadowflame Arrows have a medium velocity but a significantly longer arc. The Shadowflame Bow also has a base 7% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Shadowflame Hex Doll.info: The Shadowflame Hex Doll is a Hardmode magic weapon that fires a spread of three curving purple tentacle projectiles per use at a medium range, inflicting the Shadowflame debuff onto enemies for 4–8 seconds, and piercing 2 targets before dissipating on the 3rd hit. The third tentacle fired in each use is always aimed directly towards the cursor, but the first two keep their random spread. The Shadowflame Hex Doll also has a base 7% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Shadowflame Knife.info: The Shadowflame Knife is a Hardmode melee weapon that has a 1/6 (16.67%) / 1/3 (33.33%) chance to drop from Goblin Warlocks during the Goblin Army event. When used, it fires a small gravity-affected knife projectile that can bounce off enemies up to two times, but dissipates upon contact with blocks. It inflicts the Shadowflame debuff for 1–3 seconds on hit. The Shadowflame Knife also has a base 7% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Shark Fin.info: The Shark Fin is a crafting material that has a 19/20 (95%) chance of being dropped by Sharks and Orcas found in the Ocean biome, and a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Sand Sharks during a Sandstorm.

Shark Tooth Necklace.info: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

Sharkron Balloon.info: The Sharkron Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Tsunami in a Bottle and the Balloon Pufferfish. It boosts jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30% increasing the player's first jump's height to ~10½ tiles (~75% increase), and provides a double jump that can reach a height of 13 tiles, for a total height of 23½ tiles.

Shield of Cthulhu.info: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy.

Shiny Red Balloon.info: The Shiny Red Balloon is an accessory that increases the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the height that the player can jump from 6 tiles to ~10½ tiles, effectively a ~75% boost. However, it reduces jump height when underwater, from 8 tiles to ~7 tiles. The Shiny Red Balloon has a 1/4 (25%) of being found inside Skyware Chests on Floating Islands, as well as a 1/4 (25%) chance of being obtained from Sky Crates and Azure Crates.

Shiny Stone.info: The Shiny Stone is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that is always dropped from Golem's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While the player is not moving, not using any items, and not being damaged, the Shiny Stone greatly boosts the player's base health regeneration (i.e., the natural health regeneration without any buffs or debuffs) by accelerating its buildup and increasing the maximum rate, as well as providing +10% base health regeneration.

Shoe Spikes.info: The Shoe Spikes are an accessory that lets players partially "stick" to the sides of blocks, slowly sliding down them when moving against them in midair. Jumps can also be performed off the sides of blocks. By repeatedly sticking and jumping, vertical blocks can be scaled. When sliding down, the slide speed can be accelerated using the ▼ Down key. Shoe Spikes can be found in Gold Chests found in Underground and Cavern layers, and in Rich Mahogany Chests found in the Underground Jungle.

Shotgun.info: The Shotgun is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 25 Gold. When used, it fires a spread of 4–5 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Shroomerang.info: The Shroomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that is dropped by Spore Bats with a 1/40 (2.5%) chance.

Shroomite Bar.info: The Shroomite Bar is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bar.

Shuriken.info: The Shuriken is a consumable ranged weapon. It can hit up to 4 targets. Shurikens can be found in Pots and Chests around the world, and can be purchased from the Merchant for 15 Copper each.

Sickle.info: The Sickle is a tool that produces Hay blocks when used to cut wild grass plants and sea oats. The collected Hay can be used for building purposes and crafted into Target Dummies and Hay Walls.

Silk.info: Silk is an item used to craft the Bed, as well as several placeable decorative items and vanity clothing items.

Silver Bar.info: The Silver Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Silver Bow.info: The Silver Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Silver Bracer.info: The Silver Bracer is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron accessory that can be obtained as secondary loot from Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and from Golden Lock Boxes found in Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates.

Silver Broadsword.info: The Silver Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Silver Shortsword.

Silver Ore.info: Silver Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Silver Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Silver Shield.info: The Silver Shield is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron shield accessory.

Silver Shortsword.info: The Silver Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Silver Broadsword.

Silver Watch.info: Watches are informational accessories that show the current in-game time in the top-right corner of the screen.

Skiphs' Paws.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Sky Blue Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Sky Blue Flower.info: The Sky Blue Flower is a type of plant. It grows on Jungle grass in any layer except the Underworld, or on regular Sand Blocks submerged in at least 2 tiles of any liquid above surface. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Sky Blue Dye.

Sky Blue String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Sky Dragon's Fury.info: The Sky Dragon's Fury is a Hardmode, post-Golem melee weapon that possesses two different modes of attack.

Sky Fracture.info: The Sky Fracture is a Hardmode wand. When used, it summons three energy swords in quick succession around the player, aiming at the cursor's location. The swords do not pierce enemies and cannot pass through blocks. The Sky Fracture also has a base 24% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Slap Hand.info: The Slap Hand is a Hardmode broadsword that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 25 Gold during a Blood Moon. It is notable for having extremely high base knockback – a rating of 20, one of the highest values among all player-caused sources of knockback. The Slap Hand also has a 19% base critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%.

Sleepy Octopod.info: The Sleepy Octopod is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss melee weapon that is dropped by Ogres during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/10 (10%) / 1/5 (20%) chance during Tier 2, and a 1/20 (5%) chance during Tier 3. When used, it is swung continuously in a 360° radius around the player. After swinging for 0.7 seconds, a large shockwave occurs, dealing 300% of the weapon's damage (150 base damage) with an additional 25% critical hit chance. However, the explosion does not infict knockback.

Slime Spear.info: The Slime Spear is a pre-Hardmode spear that inflicts the Slime debuff for 3 seconds on hit.

Slime Staff.info: The Slime Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Baby Slime minion. It bounces towards enemies, dealing contact damage.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Slime Whip.info: The Slime Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip.

Snake Band.info: The Snake Band is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance of dropping from Lamias in the Underground Desert. When equipped, every third attack with a whip causes the player to automatically perform an extra whip swing at the same time. If 2 seconds have passed since the last time the player used a whip, their next whip attack will also trigger the extra whip swing, and afterwards it will be triggered again on every third whip attack.

Snapping Stone.info: The Snapping Stone is a pre-Hardmode accessory that has a 1/80 (1.25%) chance of dropping from Granite Golems and Granite Elementals.

Snapthorn.info: The Snapthorn is a pre-Hardmode whip.

Sniper Rifle.info: The Sniper Rifle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that has a 1/12 (8.33%) / 23/144 (15.97%) chance of being dropped by Skeleton Snipers in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires bullets at an extremely high damage and velocity, with a slow fire rate. It also converts Musket Balls and Tungsten Bullets into High Velocity Bullets, giving them the special effects but not affecting their damage. The Sniper Rifle has a base 29% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%.

Sniper Scope.info: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory.

Snow Block.info: Snow Blocks are blocks found naturally-placed in the Snow biome. Snow Blocks placed in the Surface layer, either naturally or by a player, will cause a snowfall effect. This is purely visual, and has no functional effects. Snow Blocks cannot be infected by The Hallow or evil biomes. Snow in any form cannot be melted into water, nor produced from water or Ice Blocks.

Snowball.info: The Snowball is a consumable ranged weapon that can be crafted from Snow Blocks. Snowballs can also be used as ammunition for the Snowball Cannon.

Snowball Cannon.info: The Snowball Cannon is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon which uses Snowballs as ammunition. The Snowball Cannon has a 15.52% chance of being found inside Frozen Chests in the Ice biome, as well as a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being obtained from Frozen and Boreal Crates.

Snowball Launcher.info: The Snowball Launcher is a pre-Hardmode furniture item and placeable weapon that has a 1/25 (4%) chance of being dropped by Snow Flinx. Once placed, interacting with it using the ⚒ Use / Attack button causes it to fire a Snowball that damages enemies, and holding the button will cause it to release a rapid fire of Snowballs with a spread of roughly 30°. The Snowball Launcher has a firing cooldown of 0.12 seconds, giving it a maximum fire rate of 8.57 Snowballs per second.

Snowman Cannon.info: The Snowman Cannon is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that is dropped from the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.. When used, it consumes rockets and fires homing snowman-shaped rockets that explode on impact with enemies.

Soaring Insignia.info: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities.

Solar Eruption.info: The Solar Eruption is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist melee weapon that swings a long whipsword from the player's position towards the cursor. The whipsword sweeps in a narrow arc of varying length before quickly retracting. It can pass through blocks and pierce infinitely. The whipsword creates a Solar Explosion upon hit, dealing damage and inflicting the Daybroken debuff for 5 seconds, which deals 100 damage per second.

Solar Fragment.info: The Solar Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100. Solar Fragments can be used to craft Solar Flare armor, an end-game armor set that benefits all types of melee weapons, as well as Solar-themed tools, weapons, wings, etc.

Solar Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Solidifier.info: The Solidifier is a crafting station used to craft Slime furniture, some miscellaneous blocks, and two weapons: the Slime Spear and Slime Whip. The Solidifier is always dropped by King Slime, and is also always placed on the starting island of a newly generated Skyblock world.

Sorcerer Emblem.info: The Sorcerer Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases magic damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Soul of Flight.info: The Soul of Flight is a Hardmode crafting material used to craft several different types of wings and the Soul of Flight in a Bottle(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).

Soul of Fright.info: The Soul of Fright is one of the six souls. It is a crafting material dropped by Skeletron Prime.

Soul of Light.info: Soul of Light is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Underground Hallow (in the Cavern layer) with a 1/5 (20%) chance. This also includes enemies not native to the biome, such as Granite Elementals. See Notes for details.

Soul of Might.info: The Soul of Might is one of the six souls. It is a crafting material dropped by The Destroyer.

Soul of Night.info: Soul of Night is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Cavern layer of an Underground Corruption or Underground Crimson biome with a 1/5 (20%) chance. This also includes enemies not native to the biome, such as normal cavern enemies, Underworld enemies, but not enemies spawned from statues. See Notes for details.

Soul of Sight.info: The Soul of Sight is one of the six souls that can be obtained in Hardmode. It is a crafting material dropped by The Twins.

Soulscourge.info: The Soulscourge is a pre-Hardmode whip.

Space Gun.info: The Space Gun is a pre-Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires fast green lasers that can hit up to three enemies. The lasers will increase in damage, pierce, knockback and size (only visually) as they travel. While a full set of Meteor armor is equipped, the Space Gun costs no mana to use.

Spear.info: The Spear is a pre-Hardmode spear that has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being found in Wooden Chests that are located on the surface as well as in the underground layer.

Spectre Bar.info: The Spectre Bar is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bar.

Spectre Boots.info: The Spectre Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory crafted from Rocket Boots and either Hermes Boots, Flurry Boots, Sailfish Boots(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), or Dunerider Boots(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), and combines their functionality (except the faster speed on sand from Dunerider Boots).

Spectre Goggles.info: The Spectre Goggles are a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron accessory which allows the player to see Echo Blocks, Echo Platforms, Echo Walls, Ghostly Stinkbug Blockers, and tiles painted with Echo Coating while equipped. They are sold by the Cyborg and Mechanic for 10 Gold when they are spoken to in a Graveyard.

Spectre Staff.info: The Spectre Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 (5%) / 39/400 (9.75%) chance of being dropped by Ragged Casters in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires a homing orb that pierces two enemies but cannot pass through blocks.

Spectre Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Spell Tome.info: The Spell Tome is a Hardmode crafting material that is purchased from the Wizard for 5 Gold.

Spider Fang.info: The Spider Fang is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Black Recluses in Spider Nests with a 1/2 (50%) / 9/10 (90%) chance. It can be used to craft several minion-related items and armor.

Spider Staff.info: The Spider Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Spider minion. It runs towards enemies and latches onto them, repeatedly dealing damage while latched and inflicting the Acid Venom debuff for 2–4 seconds. It can climb background walls and jump high.

Spiky Ball.info: The Spiky Ball is a consumable ranged weapon that is primarily used as a passive trap by tossing it to the ground, where enemies who pass over it will take damage up to 7 times (after which the Spiky Balls vanish). If not destroyed, it will automatically vanish after 1 minute 20 seconds but can be removed early by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it. It can also be directly thrown at enemies, but it has a very short arc and quickly falls to the ground.

Spinal Tap.info: The Spinal Tap is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron whip.

Spirit Flame.info: The Spirit Flame is a Hardmode magic weapon that causes a small purple flame to appear in a random location around the player and hovers in midair when used. When an enemy comes within 25 tiles and has a clear line of sight to the flame, it will home in on that enemy. Upon impact with any enemy or block, it will cause a small explosion, dealing splash damage. The Spirit Flame can be used repeatedly to summon multiple flames, and the flames dissipate if no target is acquired within 4 seconds of casting.

Spooky Twig.info: The Spooky Twig is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material used solely for crafting Spooky Wings. It is dropped by the Mourning Wood during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.86–20% (5–20%) chance depending on the current wave.

Spooky Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Spooky Wood.info: Spooky Wood is a type of wood dropped by Splinterlings and Mourning Wood during the Pumpkin Moon event. It is used to craft Halloween-themed furniture and Spooky armor.

Spore Sac.info: The Spore Sac is a Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from Plantera's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it continuously spawns multiple floating Spore Traps around the player, which will slowly home in on enemies. The Spore Traps can pass through blocks and deal 70 classless damage and a knockback of 1.5 (Extremely weak) upon hitting enemies, and inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–10 seconds.

Squire's Shield.info: The Squire's Shield is a shield accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%. It is dropped by the Dark Mage with a 1/4 (25%) / 1/2 (50%) chance.

Staff of Earth.info: The Staff of Earth is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem. When used, it fires a Boulder that is affected by gravity, bounces off blocks and rolls on the ground, and can pierce enemies five times, before dissipating on the sixth hit. The Boulder's base damage and knockback depend on its velocity. The Staff of Earth also has a base 24% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%.

Staff of the Frost Hydra.info: The Staff of the Frost Hydra is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons the Frost Hydra sentry. It fires Frost Blasts towards enemies, which pierce twice and inflict the Frostbite debuff.

Stake Launcher.info: The Stake Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera repeater that consumes Stakes as ammunition. When used, it fires Stakes that pierce nine enemies, are unaffected by gravity, and have a higher velocity than most arrows. The Stake Launcher applies a 10% damage penalty to the next hit for each enemy pierced. The Stake Launcher has a base 14% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%.

Stalker's Quiver.info: The Stalker's Quiver is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Magic Quiver with the aggro-reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

Star Anise.info: The Star Anise is a consumable ranged weapon, similar to Shurikens although slightly stronger. It can hit up to 6 targets. 20–40 can drop from Presents obtained during the Christmas event, with a 6.301% chance in pre-Hardmode and a 5.881% chance in Hardmode.

Star Cannon.info: The Star Cannon is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that consumes and fires Fallen Stars. The projectiles are not affected by gravity, pierce an infinite amount of enemies, and dissipate after 1 minute or upon impact with a block.

Star Cloak.info: The Star Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that causes three stars to fall around the player whenever the player takes damage. It consumes no mana. The stars pass through blocks until reaching the player's altitude, at which point they continue falling until hitting blocks. They can pierce once, dissipating on the second hit.

Star Veil.info: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

Star Wrath.info: The Star Wrath is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When swung, it causes three pink stars to fall toward the cursor. The stars can pierce one enemy and pass through blocks until they are at the cursor's altitude or less than 12.5 tiles above the player's center, after which they will dissipate upon contact with a block.

Starcrash.info: The Starcrash is a pre-Hardmode whip.

Stardust Cell Staff.info: The Stardust Cell Staff is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist summon weapon that summons a Stardust Cell minion. It hovers near enemies, firing a homing mini-cell that attaches itself to the target, inflicting the Celled debuff to deal 20 damage per second (20 damage displayed every 1 second). A maximum of 10 mini-cells can be attached to one target at a time, for a total of 200 damage per second (200 damage displayed every 1 second). The Stardust Cell will teleport to enemies out of range.

Stardust Dragon Staff.info: The Stardust Dragon Staff is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist summon weapon that summons a Stardust Dragon minion. It flies towards enemies, dealing contact damage and dashing to catch up with its target. It can move through and target enemies through blocks.

Stardust Fragment.info: The Stardust Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100. Stardust Fragments can be used to craft Stardust armor, an end-game armor set that benefits all types of summon weapons, as well as Stardust-themed tools, weapons, wings, etc.

Stardust Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Starfury.info: The Starfury is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being found inside Skyware Chests on Floating Islands, as well as a 1/4 (25%) chance of being obtained from Sky Crates and Azure Crates. When swung, it occasionally summons a star projectile that falls from the sky to the cursor. The star deals 150% of the weapon's damage (37 base damage) and pierces once before dissipating on the second hit, but inflicts no knockback.

Starlight.info: The Starlight is a Hardmode, post-Plantera shortsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. When used, it rapidly emits short-range light beams that pierce infinitely. It also has a base 14% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Steampunk Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Stellar Tune.info: The Stellar Tune is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic weapon that fires pairs of star-shaped projectiles that travel in a wave-like pattern toward the cursor and home in on enemies, travel through solid blocks, and explode in a small radius upon impact. Star projectiles will have their damage reduced by 25% (down to 63 base damage) when the line of sight between the player and the projectiles' point of impact is obstructed.

Step Stool.info: The Step Stool is a pre-Hardmode accessory.

Sticky Bomb.info: The Sticky Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.

Sticky Dirt Bomb.info: The Sticky Dirt Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Dirt Bomb, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.

Sticky Dynamite.info: Sticky Dynamite is an explosive that functions like Dynamite, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.

Sticky Grenade.info: The Sticky Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon. It can be made by combining Grenades with Gel. Like the Sticky Bomb, it will not roll, and will instead stick to the first block it touches until it explodes.

Sticky Power Bomb.info: The Sticky Power Bomb is a Hardmode explosive that functions like the Power Bomb, but sticks onto any block on contact. If the block it sticks to is removed by some means, it will fall until it hits another.

Stinger.info: The Stinger is a crafting material used in various Jungle-themed crafting recipes. It is obtained from Spiked Jungle Slimes, Hornets, and Moss Hornets found in the Underground Jungle biome.

Stinger Necklace.info: The Stinger Necklace is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is obtainable after defeating the Queen Bee. This item combines the Shark Tooth Necklace and the Honey Comb accessories, giving the player 5 armor penetration as well as releasing 1–3 / 1–4 bees when the wearer takes damage and granting the Honey buff for 5 seconds.

Stinkbug.info: The Stinkbug is a harmless critter which spawns on the surface. The Stinkbug has only 5 health and no defense, and can be damaged by other enemies and players.

Stone Block.info: The Stone Block is a type of block that is generated naturally in very large parts of the world. The majority of the Underground and Cavern layers is comprised of Stone Blocks. As a crafting ingredient, they are vital early in the game to craft the Furnace and Wooden Arrows.

Stopwatch.info: The Stopwatch is an informational accessory that displays the player's current movement speed in miles per hour, e.g. "34 mph".

Storm Spear.info: The Storm Spear is a pre-Hardmode spear that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis. When thrust, it fires an electric bolt that deals 160% of the weapon's damage (21 base damage) and inflicts 50% its knockback (base knockback of 3 (Very weak)). The bolt does not pierce enemies and cannot pass through blocks.

Stress Ball.info: The Stress Ball is an accessory that has a 1/100 (1%) chance to be dropped by Hoplites. When equipped, while not moving and with the inventory closed, the player will automatically and continuously use the weapon or tool that they are holding. Not all items can be used this way (see below).

Strung Counterweight.info: The Strung Counterweight is an accessory which combines the functionalities of a counterweight and a string.

Sturdy Fossil.info: The Sturdy Fossil is a block and crafting material used to make bone- and fossil-themed gear. Sturdy Fossils are obtained by consuming Desert Fossils at an Extractinator, with a 10% chance of acquiring a Sturdy Fossil from each Desert Fossil. They can also be obtained from Tomb Crawlers, Basilisks, Oasis Crates, and Mirage Crates.

Stylish Scissors.info: The Stylish Scissors are a pre-Hardmode broadsword that have a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by the Stylist. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging the weapon will throw the scissors in the direction of the cursor. The thrown scissors travel forward for 0.25 seconds before sharply dropping down, and can pierce through one enemy before dissipating on the second hit. The weapon and its projectiles both inflict the Bleeding debuff for 4–6 seconds on hit.
