Stynger.info: The Stynger is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that consumes Stynger Bolts as ammunition. When used, it fires high-velocity Stynger Bolts that explode upon contact with enemies or blocks. The explosion additionally releases 2–5 shrapnel fragments that spread out in random directions and can also explode, each dealing the weapon's full damage and knockback. The main Stynger Bolt deals double damage (124 base damage), but not its explosion.

Summoner Emblem.info: The Summoner Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases summon damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Sun Stone.info: The Sun Stone is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory which has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Moon Stone; however, these bonuses only activate during the day.

Sunfury.info: The Sunfury is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron flail that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3 seconds on hit. The Sunfury also has a base 11% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Super Star Shooter.info: The Super Star Shooter is a Hardmode ranged weapon that, as a direct upgrade to the Star Cannon, consumes and fires Fallen Stars. The projectiles are not affected by gravity, pierce an infinite amount of enemies, and dissipate into visual light-emitting particles after 1 minute or upon impact with a block.

Sweet Barb.info: The Sweet Barb is a pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it releases 1–3 homing Bee projectiles that attack nearby enemies each time the player takes damage, and grants the Honey buff for 5 seconds after being damaged. In addition, arrows fired by the player inflict the Poisoned debuff for 1.5 seconds and have a maximum chance of 1/5 (20%) to summon 3–6 homing Bee projectiles on hit.

Sweetheart Necklace.info: The Sweetheart Necklace is an accessory which releases a concentrated burst of bees and grants the player the Panic! and (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Honey buffs when damaged, increasing movement speed by 100% for (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 8 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 5 seconds and (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) health regeneration for 5 seconds.

Swordfish.info: The Swordfish is a pre-Hardmode spear obtainable through fishing in the Ocean biome.

Tabi.info: The Tabi is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory which allows the player to perform a dash by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, or the Dash button once. The dash ability has a one-second cooldown between uses. The Tabi has a 1/12 (8.33%) / 23/144 (15.97%) chance to drop from Bone Lees in the post-Plantera Dungeon.

Tackle Box.info: The Tackle Box is an accessory that decreases the chance of bait consumption while fishing. The Tackle Box can be acquired as a 1/34 (2.94%) chance reward for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC, depending on the number of completed quests and other factors (see Angler § Quest rewards for details).

Tactical Shotgun.info: The Tactical Shotgun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that has a 1/12 (8.33%) / 23/144 (15.97%) chance of being dropped by Tactical Skeletons in the Hardmode Dungeon. When used, it fires six bullets in a spread, consuming one piece of ammunition.

Tally Counter.info: The Tally Counter is a post-Skeletron informational accessory that displays the number of enemies of a specific type that have been killed. The Tally Counter will first display "Kill count unavailable" underneath the minimap. After an enemy has been attacked, the text will display how many times that enemy has ever been killed by all players combined in that world. Only the last attacked enemy's count is displayed.

Tattered Bee Wing.info: The Tattered Bee Wing is a rare Hardmode crafting material dropped by Moss Hornets with a (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 1/100 (1%) / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 1/150 (0.67%) chance. It is used solely to craft Bee Wings.

Tattered Fairy Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Teal Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Teal Mushroom.info: The Teal Mushroom is a type of mushroom. It grows on Dirt, Stone, Mud, or regular Jungle grass in the Underground and Cavern layers. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Teal Dye.

Teal String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Tempest Staff.info: The Tempest Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Sharknado minion. It hovers near enemies, dealing contact damage and firing Mini Sharkron projectiles that visually splatter upon contact with enemies or blocks. The Tempest Staff has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron.

Templar's Sling.info: The Templar's Sling is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory.

Tendon Bow.info: The Tendon Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Tentacle Spike.info: The Tentacle Spike is a pre-Hardmode broadsword dropped by Eaters of Souls, Devourers, Crimeras, Face Monsters, and Blood Crawlers with a 1/525 (0.19%) chance. When swung, it sticks tentacle spikes into enemies on hit, which linger on the enemy and deal 3 damage per second for 9 seconds. The spikes can stack up to 5 times on each target.

Terra Blade.info: The Terra Blade is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword. When swung, a green aura follows the swing, reaching farther than the sword itself. The aura can hit up to three enemies. The sword will also fire a green slash projectile that pierces infinitely, dealing the weapon's damage but reducing its damage by 25% of its current damage for each target it pierces. The projectile will dissipate after 1.5 seconds, upon contact with blocks, or when its damage falls to 0 after piercing.

Terragrim.info: The Terragrim is a pre-Hardmode melee weapon. When used, it rapidly releases slashes aimed towards the cursor. Anything within this area takes constant damage at a rate exceeding the weapon's stated use time.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Terraprisma.info: The Terraprisma is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Terraprisma minion. It flies towards enemies, performing a quick stab before repeatedly attacking with a swinging or stabbing motion. Terraprisma arrange themselves in a wing-like pattern behind the player, and immediately return to the player if no enemies are nearby.

Terrarian.info: The Terrarian is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. It rapidly fires short-lived green orbs towards nearby enemies that bounce off blocks. It also has a base 14% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Terraspark Boots.info: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory crafted from Frostspark Boots and Lava Waders, and combines their functionality.

The Bee's Knees.info: The Bee's Knees is a pre-Hardmode bow that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into a line of Bee Arrows. Bee Arrows are unaffected by gravity and disperse upon contact with an enemy or solid block, spawning three small homing bee projectiles with three independent 1/3 (33.33%) chances to spawn an extra bee.

The Eye of Cthulhu.info: The Eye of Cthulhu is a Hardmode, post-Plantera yoyo that has a 1/3 (33.33%) / 5/9 (55.56%) chance of being dropped by Mothrons during a Solar Eclipse.

The Horseman's Blade.info: The Horseman's Blade is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that can be dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. When swung, an orange aura follows the swing, reaching farther than the sword itself. The aura can hit up to three enemies. Upon striking an enemy, The Horseman's Blade summons a Flaming Jack, a homing pumpkin head projectile that can pass through blocks.

The Meatball.info: The Meatball is a pre-Hardmode flail.

The Plan.info: The Plan is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Slow and Confused debuffs.

The Rotted Fork.info: The Rotted Fork is a pre-Hardmode spear that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Crimson Hearts found in The Crimson or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Crimson Crates and Hematic Crates. When thrust, it creates a small shockwave at its tip.

The Undertaker.info: The Undertaker is a pre-Hardmode gun. It will always drop from the first Crimson Heart destroyed in a Crimson world (along with 100 Musket Balls) and has a 1/5 (20%) chance of dropping from destroyed Crimson Hearts afterward. It also has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from Crimson and Hematic Crates fished in the Crimson.

Thorn Chakram.info: The Thorn Chakram is a pre-Hardmode boomerang. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not necessarily return immediately upon contact with objects, but instead can bounce off blocks before returning. The Thorn Chakram has a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff.

Throwing Knife.info: The Throwing Knife is a consumable ranged weapon. It can hit up to 2 targets. It can be purchased from the Merchant during a Blood Moon for 50 Copper each and may also be found in Chests. The Throwing Knife is greatly affected by gravity and arcs similarly to Shurikens and Bones. It has the greatest range out of these consumable ranged weapons (with Bones having the least).

Thunder Zapper.info: The Thunder Zapper is a pre-Hardmode wand that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis. When used, it fires a lightning bolt that travels in a zigzag pattern horizontally (but traveling straight when shooting directly up or down). The bolt dissipates with a visual explosion after traveling for about one second or upon hitting an enemy or a block.

Tiger Climbing Gear.info: Tiger Climbing Gear is an accessory that allows for sliding down or completely stopping while touching walls. Holding the ▼ Down key while clinging to a wall allows the player to slide down walls a little faster than if they only had one of the ingredient accessories. While either clinging or sliding, the player can jump off of the wall, allowing them to scale vertical surfaces with ease. This accessory is useful if paired with wings, as the player's flight time is reset when latching onto a wall.

Tin Bar.info: The Tin Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Tin Bow.info: The Tin Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Tin Broadsword.info: The Tin Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Tin Shortsword.

Tin Ore.info: Tin Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface. Tin Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Tin Shortsword.info: The Tin Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Tin Broadsword.

Tin Watch.info: Watches are informational accessories that show the current in-game time in the top-right corner of the screen.

Tinkerer's Workshop.info: The Tinkerer's Workshop is a flat-surface item and crafting station that is used primarily to combine multiple accessories into single items that usually provide the abilities of their components. For instance, it can combine the Rocket Boots and Hermes Boots into a single item (the Spectre Boots) that provides the same rocket-jumping and accelerated movement as the individual items do, without occupying two accessory slots. The Tinkerer's Workshop can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 Gold.

Tissue Sample.info: The Tissue Sample is a pre-Hardmode crafting material dropped from Creepers (and the Brain of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode).

Titan Glove.info: The Titan Glove is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by Mimics.

Titanium Bar.info: The Titanium Bar is a Hardmode bar.

Titanium Ore.info: Titanium Ore belongs to the third tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the third altar broken, either it or Adamantite Ore can spawn in the cavern layer, roughly at lava depth. Mining Titanium Ore requires a Mythril/Orichalcum Pickaxe or better.

Titanium Repeater.info: The Titanium Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Titanium Sword.info: The Titanium Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Titanium Trident.info: The Titanium Trident is a Hardmode spear.

Tome of Infinite Wisdom.info: The Tome of Infinite Wisdom is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss wand that possesses two different modes of attack. When used with ⚒ Use / Attack, it fires bursts of four high-velocity pages that dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks.

Toolbelt.info: The Toolbelt is a construction accessory that can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 Gold. While equipped, it grants +1 placement range, but not tool range.

Toolbox.info: The Toolbox is a construction accessory that is obtained when opening Presents dropped during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 0.309% in pre-Hardmode and 0.288% in Hardmode. While equipped, it grants +1 placement range and tool range.

Topaz.info: Topaz is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Topaz Bunny.info: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.

Topaz Squirrel.info: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.

Topaz Staff.info: The Topaz Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a yellow bolt which does not pierce and explodes upon dissipating, dealing 35% of the weapon's damage (5 base damage) and knockback (base knockback of 1.225 (Extremely weak)) to other nearby enemies within an area, but not to the target hit directly by the bolt. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).

Torch.info: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed, held, or dropped (via the Throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots, as a bonus drop from slimes, Torch Zombies, or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 Copper each.

Toxic Flask.info: The Toxic Flask is a Hardmode, post-Plantera magic weapon that has a 1/40 (2.5%) / 79/1600 (4.94%) chance of being dropped by Dr. Man Flies during the Solar Eclipse event. When used, it throws a flask with low velocity and a heavy arc that explodes into a cluster of small, damaging toxic clouds upon colliding with an enemy or surface. The clouds last for one to two seconds and cannot pass through blocks.

Toxikarp.info: The Toxikarp is a Hardmode ranged weapon that can be obtained extremely rarely by fishing in the Corruption biome in any layer.

Tragic Umbrella.info: The Tragic Umbrella is a pre-Hardmode melee weapon and held item that can be purchased from the Clothier for 10 Gold while in a Graveyard. It functions identical to the standard Umbrella, aside from dealing higher damage.

Treasure Magnet.info: The Treasure Magnet is a post-Skeletron accessory which increases the pickup range of items from 2.625 tiles to 12 tiles while equipped. When an item is within its range, before directly flying to the player, it will hover a few blocks off the ground. The Treasure Magnet has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates.

Trident.info: The Trident is a pre-Hardmode spear that has a 9/40 (22.5%) chance of being found in Water Chests, Ocean Crates, and Seaside Crates. When held while submerged in water or lava, the player is granted increased movement speed and jump height. The player can decrease fall speed by holding ▲ Up. These effects do not work in honey or Shimmer.

Trifold Map.info: The Trifold Map is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Confused debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Clowns, Giant Bats, and Light Mummies.

Trimarang.info: The Trimarang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang crafted using three different boomerangs. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of three Trimarangs that can be thrown out at one time.

True Copper Shortsword.info: The True Copper Shortsword is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee weapon obtained by throwing the Zenith into Shimmer. It functions completely identically to the Zenith, but every sword used in its attack animation is replaced with the Copper Shortsword. Throwing the True Copper Shortsword into Shimmer separates it into the component swords used to craft the Zenith.

True Excalibur.info: The True Excalibur is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses broadsword and the direct upgrade to the Excalibur. When swung, a large yellow aura with a pink edge follows the swing, reaching about twice the distance of the sword itself. The aura can hit up to six enemies.

True Night's Edge.info: The True Night's Edge is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses broadsword and the direct upgrade to the Night's Edge. When swung, a circular purple aura follows the swing, reaching farther than the sword itself. The aura can hit up to two enemies. The sword will also fire a spinning green blade that deals 50% of the weapon's damage (35 base damage) and can strike up to 3 times.

Trusty Cattiva.info: Cattiva is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Cattiva minion. It runs and jumps towards enemies, dealing contact damage. When Cattiva is falling and its target is more than 6.25 tiles above it, it can also perform a double jump with visuals similar to the Cloud in a Bottle to reach its target. Unlike the double jumps used by the player, Cattiva does not need to land on the ground to refresh its double jump and can use it endlessly while mid-air.

Trusty Foxparks.info: Foxparks is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Foxparks minion. It does not deal contact damage, but runs and shoots fireballs towards enemies that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 5–10 seconds. When the weapon is held down using ⚒ Use / Attack, Foxparks will teleport to the player and be held while using a special flamethrower attack that does not consume any ammunition. The flamethrower attack rapidly shoots flames that inflict the On Fire!

Tsunami.info: The Tsunami is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it fires a volley of five parallel arrows, consuming one arrow per use.

Tsunami in a Bottle.info: The Tsunami in a Bottle is an accessory which can be found in Wooden, Iron, Pearlwood(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), and Mythril Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).

Tungsten Bar.info: The Tungsten Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Tungsten Bow.info: The Tungsten Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Tungsten Broadsword.info: The Tungsten Broadsword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. It is the counterpart to the Tungsten Shortsword.

Tungsten Ore.info: Tungsten Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on Floating Islands. Tungsten Ore also has a small chance to appear as a bonus drop from slimes.

Tungsten Shortsword.info: The Tungsten Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. It is the counterpart to the Tungsten Broadsword.

Tungsten Watch.info: Watches are informational accessories that show the current in-game time in the top-right corner of the screen.

Twilight Grasp.info: The Twilight Grasp is a Hardmode accessory.

Umbrella.info: The Umbrella is a pre-Hardmode melee weapon. It has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being obtained from wooden Chests on the Surface or in the Underground layer, and can also be purchased for 1 Gold from the Skeleton Merchant during a Waning Gibbous.

Unholy Trident.info: The Unholy Trident is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss wand that fires high-velocity purple tridents which lose speed as they travel and have 25 armor penetration, and inflict the Shadowflame debuff for 5–10 seconds on hit. Upon contact with blocks, the tridents briefly become stuck and will deal damage to enemies that touch them. The Unholy Trident has a 1/30 (3.33%) chance of being dropped by Red Devils.

Unholy Water.info: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome (Hallow, Corruption, or Crimson for Holy Water, Unholy Water, and Blood Water respectively) when thrown. This conversion affects a roughly circular area with a radius of four tiles from the center. Enemies within this radius are also damaged slightly; this damage is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment.

Unicorn Horn.info: The Unicorn Horn is a Hardmode crafting material that is always dropped by Unicorns in The Hallow.

Uzi.info: The Uzi is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/100 (1%) chance of being dropped by Angry Trappers. When used, it rapidly fires bullets at a high velocity. It also converts Musket Balls and Tungsten Bullets(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) into High Velocity Bullets, giving them the special effects but not affecting their damage.

Valkyrie Yoyo.info: The Valkyrie Yoyo is a Hardmode, Expert Mode-exclusive yoyo that can be obtained from any Hardmode boss's Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime's) as part of Lazure's set.

Valor.info: The Valor is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron yoyo that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes.

Vampire Frog Staff.info: The Vampire Frog Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Vampire Frog minion. It hops towards enemies to deal contact damage. The Vampire Frog Staff has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Mermen.

drops.rate: More info (In I am error worlds)

Vampire Knives.info: The Vampire Knives are a Hardmode, post-Plantera melee weapon. When used, it rapidly fires a spread of 4–8 red knife projectiles. Upon hitting an enemy, each knife causes a lifesteal effect that heals the player for 7.5% of the damage dealt (rounded down), signified by a red beam connecting to the player. The knives will eventually decrease in damage and fade after traveling a certain distance.

Vasculash.info: The Vasculash is a pre-Hardmode whip.

Venom Staff.info: The Venom Staff is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses wand and the direct upgrade to the Poison Staff. When used, it fires a burst of 4–7 Venom Fangs in a spread. Each projectile pierces four enemies and inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 30 seconds.

Venus Magnum.info: The Venus Magnum is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it converts Musket Balls and Tungsten Bullets into High Velocity Bullets, giving them the special effects but not affecting their damage.

Vicious Mushroom.info: The Vicious Mushroom is a type of mushroom growing on Crimson grass or Crimson Jungle grass, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing of any weapon or tool.  Vicious Mushroom can only grow when there are proper walls behind the soil block, or no walls at all.

Vicious Powder.info: Thrown Powders are consumable items that can be used to convert blocks and walls between their pure, Crimson, or Corrupt forms. When thrown, they release a cloud of sparkling powder with a very short range, comparable to that of a broadsword, and produce a fair amount of light.

Vile Mushroom.info: The Vile Mushroom is a type of mushroom growing on Corrupt grass or Corrupt Jungle grass, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing from any weapon or tool. Vile Mushroom can only grow when there are proper walls behind the soil block, or no walls at all.

Vile Powder.info: Thrown Powders are consumable items that can be used to convert blocks and walls between their pure, Crimson, or Corrupt forms. When thrown, they release a cloud of sparkling powder with a very short range, comparable to that of a broadsword, and produce a fair amount of light.

Vilethorn.info: The Vilethorn is a pre-Hardmode wand. It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Defiled Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). When used, it extends a thorn from the player's position, which passes through blocks, pierces infinite enemies, and deals 0.17 s global invincibility.

Vine.info: Vines are crafting materials dropped by Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle biome with a 1/2 (50%) / 100% drop chance.

Violet Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Violet Gradient Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Violet Husk.info: The Violet Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Lac Beetles, which only spawn in the Underground Jungle. Its sole purpose is to make Violet Dye.

Violet String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Vitamins.info: Vitamins are a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Weak debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Corruptors and Floaty Grosses.

Volatile Gelatin.info: The Volatile Gelatin is a Hardmode accessory that periodically fires small, purple slimeballs similar to those of the Queen Slime's Regal Gel projectiles at nearby enemies. The Volatile Gelatin's projectiles are affected by gravity and can pierce up to two entities or ricochet up to two times, dissipating upon the third time. The projectiles deal 65 classless damage while inflicting a knockback value of 7 (Strong); these values are unaffected by any boosts.

Volcano.info: The Volcano is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates an explosion upon enemy hits, dealing 75% of the weapon's damage (30 base damage) to the enemy and 2 other targets in an area around the enemy. The Volcano has a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3 seconds, while its explosion is guaranteed to inflict it for the same duration.

Vortex Beater.info: The Vortex Beater is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist gun. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets with inaccurate spread. It also fires a homing, explosive Vortex Rocket every 0.583 seconds without consuming additional ammo, which deals damage equal to the weapon's damage + 20 damage (50 + 7 + 20 = 77 base damage when using Musket Balls), and a knockback of 1.25× the weapon's knockback (base knockback of 5 (Average) when using Musket Balls).

Vortex Booster.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Vortex Fragment.info: The Vortex Fragment is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting material. It is one of the four Lunar Fragments, dropped from the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events in stacks of 12–60 / 24–100. Vortex Fragments can be used to craft Vortex armor, an end-game armor set that benefits all types of ranged weapons, as well as Vortex-themed tools, weapons, wings, etc.

Vulgar Display of Flower.info: The Vulgar Display of Flower is a Hardmode whip that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Plantera.

Waffle's Iron.info: Waffle's Iron is a Hardmode broadsword that is always dropped by Mechdusa, a boss exclusive to worlds with both Remix and For the Worthy enabled. When swung, it fires a waffle projectile once per swing, which is significantly affected by gravity. The weapon itself also has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to inflict the Hellfire debuff upon contact for 5 seconds.

Wand of Frosting.info: The Wand of Frosting is a pre-Hardmode wand and the direct upgrade to the Wand of Sparking. When used, it fires a blue spark that travels in a slight curve for about 23 tiles before dissipating. The spark can pierce one enemy and has a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the Frostburn debuff for 2 seconds (2/3 (66.67%) chance) or 3 seconds (1/3 (33.33%) chance). The Wand of Frosting also has a base 14% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Wand of Sparking.info: The Wand of Sparking is a pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a spark that travels in a slight curve for about 23 tiles before dissipating. The spark can pierce one enemy and has a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff. The Wand of Sparking also has a base 14% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Warrior Emblem.info: The Warrior Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases melee damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

Wasp Gun.info: The Wasp Gun is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Plantera. When used, it fires 2–4 homing wasp projectiles that ricochet or hit enemies a maximum of three times before dissipating. The wasp projectiles also have 10 armor penetration.

Water Bolt.info: The Water Bolt is a pre-Hardmode spell book that can be found hidden within the shelves of the Dungeon, along with having a 1/40 (2.5%) chance to be dropped by Water Bolt Mimics. When used, it fires a slow-moving piercing water ball projectile that can bounce off blocks. The water ball dissipates after hitting blocks up to five times, after hitting ten enemies, or after lasting for 30 seconds.

Water Walking Boots.info: Water Walking Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that grants the ability to walk on water, honey, and Shimmer. They do not allow walking on lava. While on said liquids, pressing ▼ Down will cause the player to fall through the liquid, similarly to platforms. Water Walking Boots have a 1/10 (10%) chance of being obtained from Water Chests, Ocean Crates, and Seaside Crates.

Weather Pain.info: The Weather Pain is a pre-Hardmode wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Deerclops. When used, it fires a Hurtnado that dissipates after 9.5 seconds or after hitting 15 enemies. The Hurtnado has 10 armor penetration, bounces off blocks, and homes in on nearby enemies, attempting to hover in front of them to deal continuous damage. Only one Hurtnado can exist at a time.

Weather Radio.info: The Weather Radio is an informational accessory that displays the current weather and wind speed on the Surface, even if the player is in the Underground, Cavern, or Underworld layers.

Wet Bomb.info: Liquid bombs are explosive items that function like the Bomb, but their explosion will either place or remove liquids, instead of destroying blocks.

White Horseshoe Balloon.info: The White Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33% and jump speed by 30%, grants a double-jump, and grants +0.05 luck(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). The height of the first jump is increased from 6 blocks to 10.5 blocks (~75% increase), while the double-jump's height is increased from 8 blocks to 14.5 blocks, reaching a total of 25 blocks with both jumps.

White Paper Airplane.info: The Paper Airplane and White Paper Airplane are consumable ranged weapons. When thrown, they will travel in a different path each time, as they are affected by wind speed and direction, which is especially apparent on a Windy Day. The two variants are functionally identical. They are sometimes dropped by slimes that are carried by Windy Balloons, which can spawn during a Windy Day.

White Phaseblade.info: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them. They can be recalled by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again, which will damage enemies along the way. They can also be recalled mid-throw.

White Phasesaber.info: Phasesabers are a group of Hardmode broadswords, direct upgrades to the phaseblades with much more damage and slightly faster use time. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them.

White String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Whoopie Cushion.info: The Whoopie Cushion is a voice accessory that makes a farting sound when the player takes damage while it is equipped. It can also be used with the ⚒ Use / Attack key to play the sound at any time. The Whoopie Cushion has a 1/50 (2%) / 99/2500 (3.96%) chance of being dropped by Giant Worms and Diggers in the Underground and Cavern layers. It can also be obtained by throwing a Zombie Arm into Shimmer.

Wicked Armlet.info: The Wicked Armlet is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/25 (4%) chance to be dropped by Cursed Hammers and Crimson Axes.

Wicked Claws.info: The Wicked Claws are a Hardmode accessory.

Will's Wings.info: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly by holding the ↷ Jump button, increase mid-air agility, and provide immunity to fall damage. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time. Flight with wings is much more controlled than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range.

Wood.info: Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw. Regular Wood can be harvested from Forest trees, vanity trees, Living Trees, and Underground Cabins in underground or cavern layers, as well as by using the Faecorn.

Wooden Boomerang.info: The Wooden Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being obtained from wooden Chests on the Surface or in the Underground layer. It can also be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 1 Gold during a full moon.

Wooden Bow.info: The Wooden Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Wooden Sword.info: The Wooden Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Wooden Yoyo.info: The Wooden Yoyo is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Work Bench.info: Work Benches are a type of flat-surface furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They fulfill a house's table requirement.

Worm Scarf.info: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

Xeno Staff.info: The Xeno Staff is a Hardmode, post-Golem summon weapon that summons a UFO minion. It hovers above enemies, firing blue lasers that hit the target instantaneously. If an enemy is 18.75 to 50 tiles away, it will instantly teleport above it. The Xeno Staff has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Xenon Moss.info: Moss is a grass-like plant that grows on Stone Blocks. It comes in 11 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone, Crimstone, or Pearlstone.

Xenon Moss Fishing Bobber.info: Fishing Bobbers are accessories that change the appearance of a fishing pole's bobber and increase the player's Fishing Power by 10.

Xenopopper.info: The Xenopopper is a Hardmode, post-Golem gun that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When used, it fires a burst of 4–5 purple bubbles, consuming one bullet. The bubbles deal no damage and will bounce off solid blocks, but pop after a 0.5-second delay, each firing a bullet directly towards the cursor.

Yelets.info: The Yelets is a Hardmode, post one-mechanical boss yoyo that has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance to drop from any enemy killed in the Jungle and Underground Jungle, including in the Jungle Temple. It inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 2 seconds on hit.

Yellow Counterweight.info: Counterweights are accessories sold by the Traveling Merchant and the Skeleton Merchant. They fire a second yoyo-type projectile after hitting an enemy with a yoyo, which travels towards it, then orbits around the player. Counterweights deal the yoyo's full damage and stay active until the yoyo is retracted towards the player. There are six different color variants with identical functionalities.

Yellow Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Yellow Gradient Dye.info: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor, vanity items, and accessories. The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes (Silver Dye and Brown Dye) as well as the Dye Vat (5 Gold). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes.

Yellow Horseshoe Balloon.info: The Yellow Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 75%, grants a double-jump, and grants +0.05 luck(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). The height of the first jump is increased from 6 blocks to 10.5 blocks, while the double-jump's height is increased from 15 blocks to 26.5 blocks, reaching a total of 37 blocks with both jumps.

Yellow Marigold.info: The Yellow Marigold is a type of plant. It grows on regular grass and Hallowed grass above surface. Unlike many plants, instead of broken by any attack, it has to be harvested with a pickaxe. Its sole purpose is to make Yellow Dye.

Yellow Phaseblade.info: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them. They can be recalled by pressing ⚒ Use / Attack again, which will damage enemies along the way. They can also be recalled mid-throw.

Yellow Phasesaber.info: Phasesabers are a group of Hardmode broadswords, direct upgrades to the phaseblades with much more damage and slightly faster use time. There are nine different color variations with identical statistics. Letting go of ⚒ Use / Attack while swinging will throw the weapons, causing them to sharply drop down after traveling for 0.5 seconds or upon contact with blocks, then embed themselves in the ground and continuously damage any enemy that touches them.

Yellow Rocket.info: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 Silver each.

Yellow String.info: A string is an offensive accessory that boosts all yoyos. While equipped, the spin duration of all yoyos is increased by 50% and their maximum range is extended by 25%, plus an additional 1.9 tiles, and the maximum range of counterweights is increased from 7.8 tiles to 10.4 tiles. White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom, and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants.

Yoraiz0r's Spell.info: Yoraiz0r's Spell is a developer wing. Like other developer items, it is dropped along with its respective developer's vanity set, which is Yoraiz0r's set.

Yoyo Bag.info: The Yoyo Bag is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionalities of the Yoyo Glove, a counterweight, and string.

Yoyo Glove.info: The Yoyo Glove is a Hardmode accessory that is purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 50 Gold. While equipped, hitting an enemy with a yoyo will create a duplicate of that yoyo that rapidly orbits around the main one. If a counterweight is also equipped, the Yoyo Glove will additionally cause a duplicate counterweight to spawn upon hit, for a total of four projectiles.

Zenith.info: The Zenith is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord melee weapon. When used, it rapidly fires fast-moving swords towards the cursor in an arc returning to the player. The sword sprites can pass through blocks, pierce enemies infinitely, home in on nearby enemies, and create visual trails while traveling. The swords have varying appearances, which function identically and have the same hitbox size. The Zenith has a base 14% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Zombie Arm.info: The Zombie Arm is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/250 (0.4%) chance of being dropped by Zombies, Frozen Zombies, and Raincoat Zombies. When held, it visually appears on the player. It will also randomly release visual Zombie gore when swung.

sources.Sky Crate: The Sky Crate is a pre-Hardmode crate that can only be fished in Space, e.g. in Floating Lakes.
sources.Skyware Chest: The Skyware Chest is a storage item found only on Floating Islands.
sources.Obsidian Lock Box: The Obsidian Lock Box is a grab bag item which is always obtained from Obsidian and Hellstone Crates.
sources.Shadow Chest: The Shadow Chest is a storage item which is found only in The Underworld, generally on top of or within Ruined Houses, and contains rare items.
sources.Gold Chest (Dungeon): Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon (open with a Golden Key)
sources.Golden Lock Box: The Golden Lock Box is a grab bag item that is always obtained from Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates.
sources.Treasure Bag (Duke Fishron): Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag-like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses.
sources.Pinky (bonus drop): Forest, Underground, Cavern, Jungle, Slime Rain
